payload.name: Intuizi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Intuizi connects ChatGPT to the Intuizi data platform, where marketing teams turn de-identified signal data into audiences and deliver them to their marketing destinations. The plugin queries the Large Behavioral Model, Intuizi's flagship LQM, trained on de-identified, real-world behavioral signal. Responses include counts, statuses, and metadata. Audience data never enters the chat and is sent only to destinations configured in the Intuizi console.

What you can do:
- Look up reference catalogs: POI categories and brands, apps, web domains, CTV channels, Transactions merchants, demographic and profile attributes, countries, and signal providers.
- Estimate how large an audience would be before you build it, then create audiences from POI visits, app usage, web domains, CTV viewing, Transactions, demographics, profile attributes, home location, or your own cohorts, alone or combined with AND, OR, and NOT IN.
- Grow a completed audience with a lookalike model and follow the model run.
- Preview a frequency range, then activate the audience to a delivery destination your team has already set up in the Intuizi console.
- Create cohorts from your own files or from an existing audience, and manage projects, POI categories, brands, and location submissions.
- Check your organization's data-scan usage against its limits.

Every tool wraps a documented Intuizi API v2 endpoint, so validation, permissions, and rate limits match the API exactly. Read-only tools are marked read-only and delete tools are marked destructive. You need an Intuizi console account: connect with one-click OAuth, approve access in your browser, and the plugin sees only the projects and data your account can see.
payload.longDescription:
Intuizi将ChatGPT连接到Intuizi数据平台，营销团队可在此将去标识化的信号数据转化为受众群体，并将其传递到营销目的地。该插件会查询大型行为模型Intuizi的旗舰LQM，该模型基于去标识化的现实世界行为信号进行训练。响应内容包括数量、状态和元数据。受众数据不会进入聊天对话，仅会发送到Intuizi控制台中配置的目的地。

您可以：
- 查询参考目录：兴趣点类别和品牌、应用、网站域名、联网电视频道、交易商户、人口统计和资料属性、国家以及信号供应商。
- 在构建受众前预估规模，然后通过兴趣点访问、应用使用、网站域名、联网电视观看、交易、人口统计、资料属性、常住地或您自己的群体，单独或结合使用AND、OR、NOT IN逻辑创建受众。
- 通过相似受众模型扩展已完成的受众群体并跟踪模型运行。
- 预览频率范围，然后将受众激活到团队已在Intuizi控制台设置的交付目的地。
- 从自有文件或现有受众创建群体，并管理项目、兴趣点类别、品牌和地点提交。
- 检查组织的数据扫描使用情况与配额限制的对比。

每个工具都封装了经过文档说明的Intuizi API v2端点，因此验证、权限和速率限制与API完全一致。只读工具标记为只读，删除工具标记为破坏性操作。您需要Intuizi控制台账户：通过一键式OAuth连接，在浏览器中批准访问权限，插件仅能查看账户有权访问的项目和数据。

payload.name: GSA Per Diem by 1102tools
payload.description: 查找联邦每日补贴标准
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Independent, unofficial app developed by James Jenrette / 1102tools using public GSA per diem data. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by GSA or the U.S. government.

Look up CONUS lodging and meals-and-incidental-expenses rates by city, ZIP code, or state; see seasonal lodging and M&IE breakdowns; and estimate or compare travel per diem. Seven read-only tools provide source-backed rates and calculations. No user sign-in or API key is needed. Estimates exclude airfare and ground transportation. Verify the fiscal year, month, and work locality before using a rate.
payload.longDescription:
由James Jenrette/1102tools开发的独立非官方应用，使用公开的GSA每日补贴数据
与GSA或美国政府无关联，也未获得其认可

可通过城市、邮政编码或州份查询CONUS住宿及餐饮与杂费标准，查看季节性住宿和餐饮费用细分，并估算或对比差旅每日补贴
七项只读工具提供基于来源的费率和计算
无需用户登录或API密钥
估算不包括机票和地面交通费用
使用费率前请确认财年、月份和工作地点

payload.name: CallRail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Give ChatGPT access to your CallRail account, to analyze interaction data, manage your data and configuration, and know what marketing is working for you.
payload.longDescription: 让ChatGPT访问您的CallRail账户，以分析交互数据、管理您的数据和配置，并了解哪些营销策略对您有效。

payload.name: Voris - Human & AI Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini, Claude, and Grok are already answering with your brand. Voris tracks those citations, measures the awareness they build, and reports what they earn you in plain language. Cookieless, EU hosted, live.
payload.longDescription:
ChatGPT、Perplexity、Gemini、Claude和Grok已开始以您的品牌身份进行回答。
Voris会追踪这些引用内容，评估其带来的品牌认知度，并用通俗易懂的语言报告其为您带来的收益。
无Cookie追踪，欧盟本地托管，实时运行。

payload.name: Ask the Grid
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ask the Grid connects ChatGPT to live and historical US electricity-grid data. Check current grid conditions, find and query published market datasets, read Energy Wire briefings, explore grid assets, and manage your own alerts and saved grid assets. Results retain source, timestamp, market, and unit context.
payload.longDescription: Ask the Grid 将 ChatGPT 与实时及历史美国电力电网数据相连接。查看当前电网状况、查找并查询已发布的市场数据集、阅读 Energy Wire 简报、探索电网资产，并管理自己的警报与保存的电网资产。结果会保留来源、时间戳、市场及单位上下文信息。

payload.name: imotesa.bg
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: imotesa.bg is an independent instrument for inspecting Bulgarian properties, their observed asking-price history, and local market context. It creates canonical links for requested property filters. Prices are observed asking prices, not transaction prices.
payload.longDescription: imotesa.bg 是一个独立工具，用于检查保加利亚房产、其观察到的要价历史及当地市场背景。它为请求的房产过滤器生成规范链接。价格为观察到的要价，而非交易价格。

payload.name: Chartrades Intelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chartrades is a market data and research service. Connect your Chartrades account to view reports, check price and volume history, and see when data is stale or incomplete.
payload.longDescription: Chartrades 是市场数据和研究服务。连接您的 Chartrades 账户以查看报告、查看价格和成交量历史，并查看数据是否过时或不完整。

payload.name: ProfitHero
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Bring your HVAC, plumbing, electrical, and other trades business context into ChatGPT with ProfitHero. Pull goals, live KPIs, and weekly insights so answers, trends, and next moves are grounded in your actual ServiceTitan, HouseCall Pro, and QuickBooks data.
payload.longDescription: 通过ProfitHero将您的暖通空调、管道、电气及其他行业业务背景带入ChatGPT。拉取目标、实时KPI和周度洞察，使答案、趋势和下一步行动均基于您实际的ServiceTitan、HouseCall Pro和QuickBooks数据。

payload.name: HailPing
payload.description: 查找近期美国冰雹风暴
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: HailPing lets you search its published hail storm reports for the continental United States. Find reports by state, city, date range, reported hail size, or distance from a US city or coordinates. Each result gives the storm date, largest reported hailstone, number of qualifying reports, and a link to the public report. You can open a report for its summary, affected cities and counties, and hail size distribution, or view a city market page with its recorded hail history and frequency band. The catalog covers published events from 2025 onward using Vaisala Xweather reports. Reported hail and modeled storm footprints do not confirm property damage, and this is not a forecast or warning service.
payload.longDescription: HailPing允许您搜索其发布的美国本土冰雹风暴报告，可通过州、城市、日期范围、报告的冰雹大小，或距离美国城市及坐标的距离进行查询。每个结果包括风暴日期、最大报告冰雹石、合格报告数量以及公共报告链接。您可以打开报告查看摘要、受影响城市及县区、冰雹大小分布，或查看包含记录冰雹历史和频段的城市市场页面。该目录涵盖2025年及以后的Vaisala Xweather报告事件。报告的冰雹数据和模拟风暴范围不用于确认财产损失，本服务非天气预测或预警系统。

payload.name: TalkToData Analytics
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Explore the Google Analytics 4 property you selected in TalkToData through five read-only tools. Ask about traffic, acquisition sources, pages, devices, and a seven-day summary. The plugin fetches authorized data on demand and cannot modify your Analytics property.
payload.longDescription: 通过五个只读工具探索在TalkToData中选择的Google Analytics 4属性。可询问流量、获取来源、页面、设备和七天摘要。该插件按需获取授权数据，无法修改您的分析属性。

payload.name: EnergyIA.AR
payload.description: 阿根廷能源与矿业数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
EnergyIA.AR connects ChatGPT to official Argentine data on energy and mining, normalized and kept up to date from government and market sources.

What you can ask:
- Oil and gas: production by field, basin, formation, province, operator and well, with rankings, year-over-year changes and history since 2006.
- Who leads each sector: top operators, who is rising and falling, and side-by-side company comparisons.
- Mining: projects, production and exports by mineral and province.
- Electricity: installed capacity by technology and province, generation, demand and large industrial consumers.
- Gas network, gas consumption, the oil value chain and fuel prices at the pump.
- Energy trade: exports by port and destination, and export prices by company.
- RIGI large-investment projects, public tenders and opportunities for suppliers.
- Macro context: consumer prices and the exchange rate.

Every answer carries its source, its period and its unit, and states how far each dataset reaches. All tools are read-only. Coverage is Argentina only. Works in Spanish and English. Requires an EnergyIA.AR account.
payload.longDescription:
EnergyIA.AR将ChatGPT连接至官方阿根廷能源与矿业数据，数据来自政府和市场来源，经过标准化处理并保持实时更新。

您可以查询：
- 石油和天然气：按区块、盆地、地层、省份、运营商和井的产量，包含排名、同比变化及自2006年以来的历史数据。
- 各领域主导者：顶级运营商、正在崛起与下滑的企业，以及企业间的对比分析。
- 矿业：按矿物和省份划分的项目、产量及出口情况。
- 电力：按技术和省份划分的装机容量、发电量、需求及大型工业用户。
- 天然气管网、天然气消费、石油价值链及加油站油价。
- 能源贸易：按港口和目的地的出口情况，以及按公司划分的出口价格。
- RIGI大型投资项目、公共招标及供应商机会。
- 宏观背景：消费者价格及汇率。

每个回答都会标注来源、时间范围和单位，并说明每个数据集的覆盖范围。
所有工具均为只读模式。
仅覆盖阿根廷地区。
支持西班牙语和英语。
需要EnergyIA.AR账户。

payload.name: Tap by P3 Adaptive
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tap by P3 Adaptive answers questions from Power BI models that P3 Adaptive has made public. It lists the public models and what each one holds, reads a model's tables, columns, measures and relationships, and runs one read-only DAX query at a time against the live model through the Power BI executeQueries REST API, so every figure is current when you ask. Each answer names the model it came from. Nobody signs in. The question, the query and its results are not kept, and the caller's address is kept only as a keyed code that changes daily, used for rate limits. Tap is a pilot, so its models and limits can change.
payload.longDescription: Tap by P3 Adaptive可解答P3 Adaptive公开的Power BI模型相关问题。它列出了公开的模型及其内容，可读取模型的表格、列、度量值和关系，并通过Power BI executeQueries REST API对实时模型执行单个只读DAX查询，确保您提问时数据始终为最新状态。每个回答都会标注数据来源模型。无需登录即可使用。问题、查询及结果不会被保存，调用方地址仅以每日更新的密钥代码形式临时存储，用于限速管控。Tap目前处于试点阶段，其模型和使用限制可能随时调整。

payload.name: Adzviser Klaviyo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your Klaviyo email and SMS data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how your campaigns and flows are performing and what they are earning.

Compare opens, clicks, unsubscribes, conversions, and attributed revenue across date ranges. Break results down by campaign, flow, message, or list. Turn your marketing data into clear reports, spot trends, and see which sends are actually driving revenue.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的Klaviyo电子邮件和短信数据连接到ChatGPT。用自然语言提问，查看您的活动和流程的表现以及它们带来的收益。

在不同日期范围内比较打开率、点击率、退订率、转化率和归因收入。按活动、流程、消息或列表分解结果。将您的营销数据转化为清晰的报告，发现趋势，并查看哪些发送真正带来了收入。

payload.name: Charts by Szum
payload.description: 将数据转化为精美的图表
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Charts by Szum helps ChatGPT turn plain-language requests and raw data into polished charts. Explore curated themes and examples, validate chart definitions, and display interactive previews with SVG and PNG image links. Save results for permanent image and interactive embed links, then reopen, update, rename, or delete charts from ChatGPT or Szum Studio. Useful for reports, presentations, product work, and dashboards.
payload.longDescription: Charts by Szum帮助ChatGPT将自然语言请求和原始数据转化为精美图表。探索精选主题和示例，验证图表定义，并通过SVG和PNG图像链接显示交互式预览。保存结果以获取永久图像和交互式嵌入链接，然后从ChatGPT或Szum Studio重新打开、更新、重命名或删除图表。适用于报告、演示文稿、产品工作和仪表板。

payload.name: RaceCharts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Create and edit animated bar, line and pie charts from ChatGPT using your RaceCharts account. Start with your own data, an existing project or a ready-made example. Customize titles, colors, layouts, images, music and timeline events.
With direct saving enabled, your assistant saves your requested changes and gives you a project link. You can also preview changes before saving. You control which projects and actions your assistant can access.
When your chart is ready, ask for a video and receive a download link. Exports use your existing RaceCharts plan or export credits. A RaceCharts account is required.
payload.longDescription: 通过您的RaceCharts账户，从ChatGPT创建并编辑动态条形图、折线图和饼图。从您自己的数据、现有项目或现成示例开始。自定义标题、颜色、布局、图片、音乐和时间轴事件。启用直接保存功能后，您的助手会保存您请求的更改并提供项目链接。您也可以在保存前预览更改。您可以控制助手可访问的项目和操作。当图表准备就绪时，请求生成视频并接收下载链接。导出功能将使用您现有的RaceCharts计划或导出积分。需要RaceCharts账户。

payload.name: Supaflow
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Build and run data pipelines directly in ChatGPT. Move data across SaaS apps, databases, data warehouses, and data lakes. Transform data using dbt Core™ models and sync data to your business apps with reverse ETL. Orchestrate pipelines, manage schedules, and troubleshoot issues—all through conversation.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中直接构建和运行数据管道。
在SaaS应用、数据库、数据仓库和数据湖之间移动数据。
通过dbt Core™模型转换数据，并利用反向ETL将数据同步到您的业务应用中。
通过对话编排数据管道、管理调度任务并排查问题。

payload.name: Adzviser CallRail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Connect your CallRail call tracking data to ChatGPT with Adzviser. Ask questions in plain language to see how many calls your marketing is generating and where those calls come from.

Compare total calls, first-time callers, answered and missed calls, and call duration across date ranges. Break results down by tracking number, source, campaign, or agent. Turn your call data into clear reports and see which channels are actually driving the phone to ring.
payload.longDescription:
通过Adzviser将您的CallRail通话跟踪数据连接至ChatGPT。用自然语言提问即可查看营销活动带来的通话量及来电来源

跨日期范围对比总通话量、首次来电者、已接听/未接听电话及通话时长。按跟踪号码、来源、活动或代理拆分数据。将通话数据转化为清晰报告，查看哪些渠道真正带来电话

payload.name: NetAPI
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Registered domain data from netapi.com for 1,584 TLDs, DNS providers and registrars. Free, no plan needed: compromised domain and IP checks, search in newly registered domains by word, the most popular websites of a country, TLD, registrar and DNS-provider statistics, and the popularity rank of a domain in the NetAPI Top 1M. 
With a NetAPI plan: download links for the full list of a zone, the domains registered or deleted in the last 24 hours, all zones at once, or all domains of a DNS provider or a registrar; lists hold domain names (any plan), datasets add nameservers, hosting IP and country, emails and phone numbers to every domain (Plus or Pro).  Also domain and IP lookups.
payload.longDescription:
来自netapi.com的注册域名数据，涵盖1,584个顶级域名、DNS服务商和注册商。
免费使用无需计划：可进行受感染域名和IP检查，通过关键词搜索新注册域名，查看某国家最热门网站、顶级域名、注册商和DNS服务商统计信息，以及NetAPI前100万域名的热度排名。
订阅NetAPI计划后：可下载区域完整列表的下载链接，获取过去24小时内注册或删除的域名、一次性下载所有区域，或所有DNS服务商/注册商的域名列表；所有计划均包含域名名称，Plus或Pro计划的数据集会为每个域名添加名称服务器、托管IP和国家信息、电子邮件和电话号码。
还提供域名和IP查询功能。

payload.name: MerchantSpring
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
MerchantSpring is the marketplace analytics platform built for agencies and enterprise brands, unifying sales, profit, advertising, inventory, traffic, Buy Box, and customer performance across seller and vendor accounts on 120+ marketplaces including Amazon, Walmart, eBay, Shopify, and more.

ChatGPT pulls live, portfolio-wide metrics with period-on-period comparisons built in. Drill from the total portfolio down to a single store or SKU, covering sales trends, store and product-level profit and loss, advertising performance by channel, and on-demand report types spanning inventory health, Buy Box performance, traffic and conversion, customer lifetime value, refunds, repeat purchase and more.

Ask things like "Compare sales across all client marketplaces this month vs last", "Which SKUs ran negative margins last quarter?", "How did advertising performance shift across channels week on week?", or "Show ordered vs shipped revenue for our Amazon Vendor accounts by month". ChatGPT fetches the live numbers and does the analysis on the spot.

For agencies, that means the whole client book in one conversation - filter any query by marketplace, country, or store tags, compare performance across every account you manage, and turn the answers straight into client-ready reporting. Seller and vendor accounts are both fully supported.

Trusted by 35,000+ brands and agencies.
payload.longDescription:
MerchantSpring是专为代理商和企业品牌打造的市场分析平台，整合了亚马逊、沃尔玛、eBay、Shopify等120+个市场的销售、利润、广告、库存、流量、Buy Box及客户表现数据，覆盖卖家和供应商账户

ChatGPT可提取实时的全 portfolio 数据并内置逐期对比功能。可从整体投资组合逐层深入到单个店铺或SKU，涵盖销售趋势、店铺及产品级盈亏、分渠道广告表现，以及库存健康度、Buy Box表现、流量转化、客户终身价值、退款、复购率等按需报告类型

可提问如「比较本月与上月所有客户市场的销售额」「上季度哪些SKU出现负毛利」「每周各渠道广告表现如何变化」「展示我们Amazon供应商账户按月统计的订单与发货收入」等。ChatGPT会实时获取数据并即时完成分析

对代理商而言，可在单次对话中管理全部客户资料——通过市场、国家或店铺标签筛选任意查询，对比所管理账户的全部表现，并直接生成客户报告。卖家和供应商账户均得到全面支持

被35,000+个品牌和代理商信赖。

payload.name: Lemonado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analyze your connected marketing data.

Ask questions about marketing data connected to Lemonado, compare performance across periods, and explore results in charts and tables. Uses the projects and accounts available through your Lemonado connection.
payload.longDescription:
分析您连接的营销数据。

您可以向Lemonado查询连接的营销数据，跨周期比较表现，并在图表和表格中探索结果。使用通过您的Lemonado连接可用的项目和账户。

payload.name: CreceRank
payload.description: 拉丁美洲品牌在AI领域的可见度
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: CreceRank measures whether answer engines recommend a brand in Latin America. After the user connects an account, the plugin can create a brand, save prompts, run a visibility scan, and read scores, cited sources, recommendations, and the action list. It can also share a brand with a teammate. It does not delete the account, start a new analytics connection, or take payment.
payload.longDescription: CreceRank可检测问答引擎是否在拉丁美洲推荐某个品牌。用户连接账户后，插件可创建品牌、保存提示语、运行可见性扫描并查看评分、引用来源、推荐内容及行动清单。还可以与团队成员分享品牌。不会删除账户、启动新的分析连接或收取费用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Create a brand and save prompts, Run an AI visibility scan, Read scores, sources, and recommendations, Update the GEO playbook

payload.name: askTheco
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
askTheco gives you direct access to Thecosystems: curated intelligence on the people, activities, and professional networks that shape a therapeutic area.

You can ask who’s leading research in a therapeutic area; which institutions sit behind a trial; or who influences clinical practice or policy. Every answer is read-only and traces back to its public-domain source, so you can see exactly why a result appears, not just that it does.

askTheco covers three core capabilities:
- Searching guidelines, policy decisions, people, organisations, trials, and publications
- Building a detailed profile of a single expert or organisation
- Tracing the connections between people, activities, and organisations

Thecosystems is built by MMRG, a certified B Corp. No generative guesswork, no scraped noise. Just a therapeutic landscape you can act on with confidence.

A Thecosystems subscription is required to connect. 

Contact us to set one up.
payload.longDescription:

payload.name: HYPD.AI for Tag Manager
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
HYPD.AI for Tag Manager brings data from authorized Google Tag Manager accounts into ChatGPT, helping marketers, agencies, analytics teams, ecommerce teams, and developers understand how tracking is configured, troubleshoot implementation problems, compare versions, and make controlled changes.

Use it to:

• Discover the Google Tag Manager accounts and containers available to you, then select the correct container before beginning an audit or implementation task.

• List container workspaces and inspect complete snapshots of their tags, triggers, and variables to understand the current tracking architecture.

• Open individual tags, triggers, and variables in full to examine configuration details, firing conditions, dependencies, and naming conventions.

• Audit measurement setups for missing, duplicated, outdated, or potentially misconfigured components, including tags and triggers associated with GA4, Google Ads conversions, consent management, and other marketing or analytics platforms.

• Find overly broad or restrictive firing conditions, inconsistent naming, unnecessary duplication, orphaned variables, and other configuration risks that can affect data quality.

• Review the currently published container version and compare historical versions to understand exactly what changed, identify possible regressions, and prepare clear release notes.

• Plan tracking implementations conversationally and create drafts for new or replacement tags, triggers, and variables without immediately changing the container.

• Review proposed changes before they are applied, including the affected entities, configuration, intended outcome, and implementation reasoning.

• Create restorable container versions from approved workspace changes so each implementation has a documented release point.

• Publish an approved container version through a separate confirmation step, keeping workspace changes and live-site publication under distinct controls.

• Produce tracking audits, implementation plans, QA checklists, change summaries, and stakeholder-friendly explanations without manually documenting the entire container.

HYPD.AI only accesses accounts and containers available through the connected user. Reading, auditing, and analysis do not modify Google Tag Manager.

Changes follow a guarded workflow: HYPD.AI prepares a draft, shows the proposed change for review, requires explicit approval, and only then applies it. Publishing a version requires a separate approval. HYPD.AI cannot bypass Google Tag Manager permissions, change user access, delete containers, or silently apply unapproved changes.

Users should validate changes with Google Tag Manager’s Preview and Debug tools before publishing and remain responsible for deciding when a version is ready to go live.
payload.longDescription:
HYPD.AI for Tag Manager将授权的Google标签管理器账户数据引入ChatGPT，帮助营销人员、代理机构、分析团队、电商团队和开发人员了解跟踪配置情况，排查实施问题，对比版本差异，并进行受控修改。

使用它来：

• 发现您可用的Google标签管理器账户和容器，开始审计或实施任务前选择正确的容器。

• 列出容器的工作区并检查其标签、触发器和变量的完整快照，以理解当前的跟踪架构。

• 以完整形式打开单个标签、触发器和变量，检查配置细节、触发条件、依赖关系和命名规范。

• 审核测量设置中的缺失、重复、过时或可能配置错误的组件，包括与GA4、Google Ads转化、同意管理以及其他营销或分析平台相关的标签和触发器。

• 发现过于宽泛或限制性的触发条件、不一致的命名、不必要的重复、孤立变量以及其他可能影响数据质量的配置风险。

• 查看当前发布的容器版本，并对比历史版本以准确了解具体变更内容，识别可能的回归问题，并准备清晰的发布说明。

• 通过对话方式规划跟踪实施并创建新标签、触发器和变量的草稿，无需立即修改容器。

• 在应用变更前审查拟议修改，包括受影响实体、配置内容、预期结果及实施逻辑。

• 从已批准的工作区修改创建可恢复的容器版本，确保每次实施都有可追溯的发布节点。

• 通过独立确认步骤发布已批准的容器版本，使工作区修改与线上发布处于独立控制之下。

• 生成跟踪审计报告、实施计划、QA检查清单、变更摘要和面向利益相关者的易懂说明，无需手动记录整个容器内容。

HYPD.AI仅访问连接用户可访问的账户和容器。阅读、审计和分析操作不会修改Google Tag Manager。

变更遵循受控工作流：HYPD.AI先生成草稿，展示拟议修改供审查，需明确批准后才执行。发布版本需要独立审批。HYPD.AI无法绕过Google Tag Manager权限，不能修改用户权限、删除容器或在未经批准的情况下静默应用变更。

用户应在发布前使用Google Tag Manager的预览和调试工具验证更改，并仍需对决定何时上线版本负责。

payload.name: Simma
payload.description: 铁人三项和耐力训练指导
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Simma turns swimming, running and cycling data into coaching for triathletes and endurance athletes. It reads activities from Garmin, computes the numbers a triathlon coach actually uses — form calibrated to each athlete's own history, per-sport training status across swim, bike and run, pace and stroke detail down to the lap — and gives ChatGPT the finished picture rather than raw files.

For coaches. Whether you coach triathletes, runners, cyclists or swimmers, ask who on your roster needs attention this week and why. Open one athlete and get three weeks of sessions bucketed by week, their load against their own baseline, race goals with days to go, the linked training plan, and pre-computed flags for the things worth a message. Draft that message in your own voice, save it, and send it from Simma so replies thread back into the same conversation. Keep private notes per athlete that steer every future draft. Every number is computed by Simma; ChatGPT writes the words.

For athletes. Ask how your triathlon training is going and get an honest read against your own history, not a generic scale. Look up any swim, ride or run in detail, find the sessions where you faded or negative-split, set and track race goals, link a training plan, and message your coach — or, if you are self-coached, get the same analysis Simma gives a coach.

What it does not do. Simma never sends anything on your behalf without an explicit confirmation step, and read tools are marked read-only so ChatGPT can use them freely. Tools that overwrite a setting, delete a goal or end a coaching relationship are marked destructive so ChatGPT asks before running them. Sending a message is gated twice: the draft is shown to you in full and must be approved before it goes.

You need a Simma account; new users can create one during sign-in. Activity data comes from Garmin Connect, linked from the Simma web app. Your training history loads within a few minutes of linking, as long as historical data is allowed on Garmin's consent page.
payload.longDescription:
Simma将游泳、跑步和骑行数据转化为针对铁人三项运动员和耐力运动员的训练指导。它可从Garmin读取活动数据，计算铁人三项教练实际使用的各项指标——根据每位运动员的历史数据校准的形态、游泳/骑行/跑步各项目的训练状态、精确到每圈的配速和划水细节，并将整理好的信息而非原始文件提供给ChatGPT。

给教练的工具。无论您指导铁人三项运动员、跑步者、自行车手还是游泳者，都可以询问名单中谁需要本周关注以及原因。打开某位运动员资料后，可查看按周分组的三周训练课程，其训练负荷与自身基准线的对比、距离比赛的天数和目标赛事、关联的训练计划，以及需要特别沟通的预计算标记。用您自己的语气撰写沟通内容，保存后通过Simma发送，回复将自动延续至同一对话中。可为每位运动员添加私密备注，这些备注将指导后续所有稿件的撰写。每个数据均由Simma计算；ChatGPT负责生成文字。

给运动员的工具。可询问自己的铁人三项训练进展，获得基于自身历史数据的诚实反馈，而非通用评分标准。查看任何游泳、骑行或跑步记录的详细信息，找到表现下滑或逆向配速的训练课程，设定并追踪比赛目标，关联训练计划，并可向教练发送消息——如果为自我训练者，也能获得与教练相同的Simma分析结果。

Simma不会在未经过明确确认步骤的情况下擅自发送任何内容，且只读工具会被标记为只读，以便ChatGPT自由使用。会覆盖设置、删除目标或终止训练关系的工具会被标记为破坏性操作，ChatGPT会在执行前询问确认。发送消息需要双重验证：草稿会完整展示给您并需获得批准后才会发送。

您需要拥有Simma账户；新用户可在登录时创建账户。活动数据来自Garmin Connect，需通过Simma网页应用进行关联。在连接后几分钟内即可加载您的训练历史，前提是Garmin的同意页面已允许历史数据访问。

payload.name: Trackberry
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Trackberry gives fresh produce importers a live view of every container, and this app lets you ask about them in plain language.

Ask things like "Which containers arrive in Rotterdam this week?", "Is anything delayed from Peru?", "Which shipments are close to their free time?" or "What's on the packing list for MSKU1234567?" and get answers from your own Trackberry account: ETAs and how they changed, tracking events and vessel positions, demurrage and detention countdowns, open alerts, and the data extracted from your packing lists, invoices, bills of lading and certificates. Where a shipment is and how its journey is going show on a map.

Trackberry reads the shipping documents your suppliers and forwarders already email you, reconciles them against each other, and flags missing or inconsistent paperwork before it becomes a problem at the port. Sea and air freight are supported.

The app is read-only and sees one organization per connection. Requires a Trackberry account.
payload.longDescription:
Trackberry为新鲜农产品进口商提供每个集装箱的实时视图，这款应用允许您用通俗语言查询运输信息。

您可以询问「本周哪些集装箱将在鹿特丹到港？」、「秘鲁的货物有延迟吗？」、「哪些运输接近免费用箱期？」或「MSKU1234567的装箱单有什么内容？」等问题，所有答案均来自您的Trackberry账户：包括预计到达时间及其变化、运输节点和船舶位置、滞期费及滞留费倒计时、未处理警报，以及从装箱单、发票、提单和证书中提取的数据。货物当前所在位置和运输进度都会在地图上显示。

Trackberry可读取供应商和货代已通过邮件发送的运输文件，将文件相互核对，并在文件缺失或不一致的情况下提前标记，避免在港口造成问题。支持海运和空运。

该应用为只读模式，每个连接对应一个组织。需要Trackberry账户。

payload.name: HoverBot
payload.description: 查看聊天机器人遗漏的信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
This plugin gives ChatGPT read-only access to one HoverBot workspace, so the people who run a support bot can ask about it in plain language instead of reading dashboards.

It answers questions like: what did shoppers ask about returns last week that the bot could not answer, how does this week's conversation volume compare to last week's, and which knowledge sources mention the refund window.

HoverBot is an AI chatbot platform that answers customer questions from a company's own catalog, policies, and documentation.

Nine tools are available. list_chatbots and get_chatbot return the bots in the workspace and one bot's configuration, including its system prompt and knowledge libraries. list_knowledge_sources and search_knowledge cover the files, links, text and question-and-answer pairs that ground its replies. list_conversations and get_conversation return recent shopper conversations and full transcripts, with the retrieval confidence for each turn. get_unanswered_questions reports questions the bot answered from weak grounding and questions that produced no answer at all, each with its conversation id. get_analytics_summary returns conversation and message volume, active sessions, response rate and average response time, this week against last. list_leads returns the contact details the bots captured.

Every tool is read-only. The plugin cannot change a chatbot, edit a knowledge base, contact a lead, or alter any setting.

Access is granted by signing in to HoverBot, and the grant fixes which workspace the plugin can read. The workspace is never taken from a tool argument, so the plugin cannot reach another customer's data. Access tokens are listed in the HoverBot dashboard with the time each was last used, and revoking one takes effect on the next request.

search_knowledge matches keywords rather than meaning; the chatbot's own answering uses semantic retrieval, and this tool does not.
payload.longDescription:
此插件为ChatGPT提供对一个HoverBot工作区的只读访问权限，这样运营客服机器人的人员可以用自然语言询问相关问题，而不必阅读仪表盘。

它可以回答诸如：上周购物者询问过哪些退货问题机器人无法回答，本周对话量与上周相比如何，以及哪些知识源提到了退款期限。

HoverBot是一个AI聊天机器人平台，能够从企业的自有目录、政策和文档中解答客户问题。

提供9个工具。list_chatbots和get_chatbot可返回工作区中的聊天机器人列表及单个机器人的配置信息，包括系统提示和知识库。list_knowledge_sources和search_knowledge涵盖支撑回复的文件、链接、文本及问答对。list_conversations和get_conversation可返回最近的购物者对话和完整对话记录，并标注每轮对话的检索置信度。get_unanswered_questions会报告机器人通过弱关联性回答的问题以及完全未回答的问题，每个问题都带有对话ID。get_analytics_summary返回本周与上周对比的对话量、消息量、活跃会话数、响应率和平均响应时间。list_leads返回机器人获取的联系人信息。

所有工具均为只读模式。
该插件无法修改聊天机器人、编辑知识库、联系潜在客户或更改任何设置。

通过登录HoverBot即可获得访问权限，授权内容会固定插件可读取的工作区。
工作区不会通过工具参数传递，因此插件无法访问其他客户的数据。
访问令牌会在HoverBot仪表盘中列出，并显示每次最后使用时间，吊销令牌将在下一次请求时生效。

search_knowledge通过关键词匹配而非语义含义进行搜索；聊天机器人自身的回答功能使用语义检索，而此工具不支持。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find questions your chatbot could not answer, Read shopper conversation transcripts, Compare conversation volume week over week, Search the chatbot's knowledge sources, List leads captured by your chatbots

Use data collected in your geoSurge projects to measure how often your brand appears in AI answers, compare its share of voice with competitors, and analyze the domains and URLs cited by AI models. Explore visibility trends by model, location, topic, prompt, and reporting period, and review the search queries behind AI answers. You can also manage the brands, topics, and prompts your projects track, and manage organization membership when your account role permits it. payload.name: Orgvue AP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Orgvue is the organizational design and workforce planning platform used by enterprises to model, cost and reshape their organizations. Connect OpenAI to Orgvue to explore workforce data, organizational structures, and planning scenarios.

In plain, natural language, ask questions about your workforce data: spans and layers, headcount by function, cost of a proposed structure, the gap between your current and future-state organization, or anything else you might want to know.

Ask workforce modelling questions and see the changes happening directly in Orgvue. You’ll get trusted answers grounded in your Orgvue data. See the impact of a scenario before you commit, draft the narrative for a restructure paper, or quickly pull the numbers you need for a board meeting.

Access follows your existing Orgvue permissions. OpenAI sees only the workspaces and datasets you're already entitled to, and only when you ask.

Orgvue remains the trusted source of workforce data and organizational scenarios, while OpenAI provides a conversational way to interact with them.

What you can do:

- Summarize org structures - reporting lines, spans, layers, vacancies
- Ask the agent workforce modelling questions and instantly visualise the impact of changes in Orgvue

payload.longDescription:
Orgvue是企业用于建模、成本核算和重塑组织的组织设计和人力规划平台。
将OpenAI连接到Orgvue，探索员工数据、组织结构和规划场景。

payload.name: Preset

Available actions depend on the tools and permissions exposed by your connected account.
payload.longDescription: 通过托管的Preset MCP网关探索您的Preset数据，包含9个集成技能模块，覆盖数据发现、数据查询、图表展示、仪表盘配置、SQL实验室、数据集管理、故障排查、MCP工作流路由以及Tableau工作簿转换功能。可用操作取决于您连接账户所暴露的工具和权限。

payload.name: Ad Account Health Check
payload.description: 审计您的Meta广告导出数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ad Account Health Check reviews a Meta Ads Manager export and shows where spend is leaking.

What it checks: creative fatigue (click-through falling over the period), ad sets below your break-even ROAS, target CPA or target CPL, ad sets that perform well but are held back by their budget, under-delivering ad sets, and rejected ads. Each finding names the campaign, ad set or ad, explains why it was flagged, estimates the monthly impact where it can, and suggests a fix. You also get a 0-100 score and a list of the checks that could not run, with the reason.

How to export: in Meta Ads Manager open the Ads tab, set the date range to Last 30 days, choose Breakdown > By time > Day, then Reports > Export table data > CSV, and attach the file in ChatGPT. Ask "How do I export my Meta ads data?" for the full steps and the columns it uses.

How it works: the checks use the same deterministic rules engine and thresholds as Adcero's Optimize page, so the same file always gives the same result. Share your break-even ROAS, target CPA or target CPL to turn on the break-even checks.

What it can't check: it reads Meta exports only (not Google Ads, TikTok or other platforms); it needs an ad-level export broken down by day that covers at least 7 days; results are judged on Meta-reported purchases, which Meta's own attribution can over-count; and an export does not carry first-party store data, so new-customer cost checks are skipped.

Your account and data: it never connects to or changes your ad account; it only reads the file you share. The file itself is not stored. The derived report (score, findings and skipped checks) is kept for 14 days so you can open the full report from the link, then deleted unless you save it to an Adcero account. Privacy details: https://app.adcero.io/apps-privacy
payload.longDescription:
广告账户健康检查会分析Meta广告管理器导出数据，并显示支出流失的位置

检查内容包括：创意疲劳（点击率在周期内下降）、低于盈亏平衡ROAS的广告组、目标CPA或目标CPL、表现良好但受预算限制的广告组、表现不佳的广告组以及被拒绝的广告。每个检查结果会列出对应的广告活动/广告组/广告，说明被标记原因，估算月度影响范围，并提供解决方案。您还将获得0-100分的评分，以及无法运行的检查列表及具体原因。

导出方法：在Meta广告管理器中打开广告标签，设置日期范围为最近30天，选择分解方式>按时间>按天，然后通过报表>导出表格数据>CSV格式保存文件，并在ChatGPT中上传该文件。如需完整步骤及所用数据列，请询问「如何导出我的Meta广告数据？」

工作原理：检查功能使用与Adcero优化页面相同的确定性规则引擎和阈值，因此同一文件始终产生相同结果。提供您的盈亏平衡ROAS、目标CPA或目标CPL可开启盈亏平衡检查。

无法检查的内容：仅支持Meta导出数据（不兼容Google Ads/TikTok等其他平台）；需要包含至少7天数据的按天粒度广告层级导出；结果基于Meta报告的购买数据，而Meta自身归因可能存在重复计算；导出文件不包含第一方店铺数据，因此会跳过新客成本检查。

账户与数据安全：不会连接或修改您的广告账户；仅读取您分享的文件。文件本身不会被存储。生成的报告（评分、检查结果及未执行检查）保存14天，可通过链接打开完整报告，之后将被删除（除非您保存至Adcero账户）。隐私详情：https://app.adcero.io/apps-privacy

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Audit a Meta Ads Manager CSV export (ad level, daily breakdown), Score account health from 0 to 100, Flag creative fatigue, rejected ads and budget pacing problems, Run break-even ROAS, target CPA and target CPL checks when you provide them, Explain how to export the right report from Ads Manager

payload.name: DataHub Cloud
payload.description: 可信赖的数据与上下文
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: DataHub's MCP server gives AI agents the enterprise context they need to work with your data. Surface curated knowledge — runbooks, FAQs, business definitions, and vocabularies — so agents operate with the same shared understanding as your teams. Search across datasets, dashboards, and pipelines, then pull ownership, governance policies, quality signals, and documentation to understand what you're looking at. Trace lineage at the table and column level. Surface real SQL queries to see how data is actually used. Apply tags, glossary terms, owners, and descriptions at scale. The context layer that makes AI agents enterprise-ready.
payload.longDescription: DataHub的MCP服务器为AI代理提供企业级数据上下文，使其能够与您的数据协作。呈现经过筛选的知识库——操作手册、常见问题、业务定义和术语表——使代理能与团队保持相同的共享认知。跨数据集、看板和数据流进行搜索，然后提取所有权信息、治理策略、质量信号和文档以理解所查看的内容。在表和列级别追踪数据血缘。展示实际的SQL查询，查看数据是如何被使用的。大规模应用标签、术语表条目、负责人和描述。打造让AI代理具备企业级能力的上下文层。

payload.name: Disc Golf Scout
payload.description: 飞盘高尔夫盘价值、库存和降价信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ask what a disc golf disc is worth and get an answer based on real sold listings. Disc Golf Scout matches completed eBay sales to the exact release every night (brand, mold, plastic, stamp, player and year, so a Tour Series Luna isn't valued like a stock one) and checks US disc golf stores every 10 minutes.

Ask:
- What a disc typically resells for, new and used, and how many sales that is based on
- Whether an asking price is fair, compared with resale and with buying it new in a store
- Which stores have it in stock right now
- How fast drops of a disc or a family of releases sell out
- Which new discs just dropped, and which in-stock discs are below their usual price

Every answer links the Disc Golf Scout page it came from, with the full sales history. Read-only, no account needed.
payload.longDescription:
询问一个飞盘高尔夫盘的价值，将根据真实成交记录获得答案。
Disc Golf Scout 每晚将已完成的 eBay 销售与确切的发布版本匹配（包括品牌、模具、塑料材质、印章、球员和年份，因此 Tour Series Luna 不会像普通版本一样估值），并每 10 分钟检查一次美国飞盘高尔夫商店库存。

可查询：

每个答案都会链接到其来源的 Disc Golf Scout 页面，并附有完整的销售记录。

payload.name: Julius: Excel & Data Analysis
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius AI helps analyze Excel spreadsheets, CSV files, and other files in your personal Julius library. Use Python to clean and combine datasets, run statistical analyses, build forecasts and financial models, and generate charts, HTML dashboards, reports, and editable PowerPoint presentations.

Import a ChatGPT file attachment or use files already saved in Julius. Inspect inputs, run Python, and save results back to your personal library.

Some examples of how you can use Julius:

Excel and spreadsheet editing: Use Python to update formulas, combine worksheets, clean data, and revise budgets or forecasts in saved workbooks.
Statistics and data analysis: Run regressions and hypothesis tests, identify outliers, and visualize relationships in your data.
Business reporting: Compare revenue, costs, and performance across periods using your files, then generate charts, HTML dashboards, and reports.
Marketing analytics: Analyze campaign exports saved as spreadsheets or CSV files and produce comparison reports and charts.
Presentations: Use Python to turn datasets and analytical findings into editable PowerPoint files.

Create and revise text, code, and self-contained HTML files. When you request public sharing, publish a saved file and receive its public URL, or withdraw that link with unpublish.

Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius AI可帮助分析个人资料库中的Excel电子表格、CSV文件及其他文件。使用Python清洗和合并数据集，运行统计分析，构建预测模型和财务模型，并生成图表、HTML仪表盘、报告以及可编辑的PowerPoint演示文稿。

导入ChatGPT文件附件，或使用已保存在Julius中的文件。检查输入内容，运行Python代码，并将结果保存回个人资料库。

以下为Julius的一些使用场景：

Excel与电子表格编辑：使用Python更新公式，合并工作表，清洗数据，并修订已保存工作簿中的预算或预测。统计分析：运行回归分析和假设检验，识别异常值，并可视化数据间的关系。业务报告：通过文件对比不同时期的收入、成本和业绩，生成图表、HTML仪表盘和报告。营销分析：分析以电子表格或CSV文件保存的活动数据，生成对比报告和图表。演示文稿：使用Python将数据集和分析结果转化为可编辑的PowerPoint文件。

创建和修订文本、代码及自包含的HTML文件。请求公开分享时，可发布已保存文件并获取公共URL，或通过取消发布移除该链接。

连接您的Julius账户以开始使用。

payload.longDescription:

payload.name: CueScout
payload.description: 检查AI是否在回答中提及您的品牌
payload.summaryOriginal: Check if AI answers name you
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
CueScout checks how AI answer engines treat a website.

Ask whether an AI search engine names your brand for a question a buyer would type, and CueScout runs that question once and reports back: whether the brand was named, whether its site was cited, which of up to three competitors came up, and the pages the answer was built from. Those pages are mostly reviews, comparison posts and "best tools" lists on other people's sites, so the list tells you where the answer is coming from.

Four more checks look at the site itself and use no AI. One reads robots.txt and says whether the main AI crawlers are blocked, including by a catch-all rule nobody meant to write. Another runs eight readiness checks: crawler access, llms.txt, Organization and FAQ schema, canonical and meta tags, whether the copy is in the HTML or only appears after JavaScript runs, and whether there is an about page and a pricing page. The last two validate the JSON-LD on a single page and check that the sitemap can be fetched, parses, and is listed in robots.txt.

If you track brands in CueScout, you can connect your account and ask about them directly. The app then reads what CueScout has already collected: how often AI answers named your brand and each competitor, your share of voice, the prompts you're missing from and who got named instead, what each engine actually said, the pages those answers cited, your To-dos in priority order, and your last site audit. Connecting is read only. The app can't change settings, add prompts, run checks or buy anything, and you can disconnect it in CueScout's settings.

It's built for marketers, founders and SEO people who want a quick read on AI search in the middle of a conversation. The five checks above work without an account.

What it can't tell you: the visibility check asks an engine through its search API, not through a consumer app, so no account history, memory or location shapes the answer. One question gives one answer. A brand missing from one phrasing can show up in the next, so read a single result as one datapoint rather than a score. The site checks only read public pages and never change anything. Visibility checks have a daily limit shared by everyone using the app.
payload.longDescription:
CueScout会检查AI回答引擎如何处理您的网站。

您可以询问AI搜索引擎是否会将您的品牌作为买家搜索问题的答案，CueScout会运行该问题一次并返回结果：品牌是否被提及、网站是否被引用、最多三个竞争对手中哪个出现、以及答案来源的页面。这些页面主要是其他网站上的评论、对比文章和「最佳工具」列表，因此该列表会显示答案的来源。

四项额外检查直接针对网站本身且不使用AI。一项会读取robots.txt文件并显示主要AI爬虫是否被阻止，包括那些无意中被写入的全局限制规则。另一项会执行八项就绪检查：爬虫访问权限、llms.txt文件、组织结构和FAQ结构数据、规范标签和元标签、内容是否直接存在于HTML中而非仅在JavaScript运行后出现，以及是否包含关于页面和定价页面。最后两项会验证单页的JSON-LD有效性，并检查站点地图是否可获取、可解析且列在robots.txt中。

如果您在CueScout中跟踪品牌，可以连接账户并直接查询这些品牌。应用会读取CueScout已收集的信息：AI回答中提及您的品牌及每个竞争对手的频率、您的品牌曝光度占比、您错过的提示词以及被提及的替代品牌、各搜索引擎实际返回的内容、答案引用的页面、按优先级排序的待办事项清单，以及最近的网站审计记录。连接操作为只读模式。应用无法更改设置、添加提示词、执行检查或购买任何东西，您可以在CueScout的设置中随时断开连接。

该工具专为需要在对话中快速了解AI搜索情况的营销人员、创始人和SEO人员设计。上述五项检查无需账户即可使用。

它无法告知您：可见性检查通过搜索引擎的搜索API提问，而非通过消费者应用，因此不会受账户历史记录、记忆或位置影响。一个问题仅提供一个答案。某个品牌可能在一种表述中未出现，但在下一种表述中出现，因此请将单个结果视为一个数据点而非评分。网站检查仅读取公开页面且永远不会修改任何内容。可见性检查存在每日限额，所有用户共享该限额。

payload.name: Reckon
payload.description: 为什么你的广告会胜出或失败
payload.summaryOriginal: Why your ads win or lose
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Ad dashboards tell you which ad won. Reckon tells you why.

Reckon reads every video and image you run on Meta and Google and tags what is inside it: the spoken hook, the angle, the claims, the format, the call to action and the full transcript. Then it ties each of those to what the ad spent and earned, so you can ask which hooks and angles actually sell, and get an answer from your own ads rather than best practice.

It does the same for your competitors. Reckon tracks the brands you name in the Meta Ad Library and tags their ads the same way as yours, so you can see the angles they run that you do not, which of their ads they keep running, and where the market is crowded or empty.

What you can ask:
- Which hooks, angles and formats cost least per result in our own ads?
- What do our best ads have in common, and where do viewers drop off in our videos?
- What are competitors saying that we are not? Give me test candidates.
- Which ads should we cut or scale? Every ad is judged against the other ads selling the same product, with the evidence behind each call.

Meta and Google come back in one answer. Anything that cannot be added together, such as two currencies, is named rather than summed.

Reckon does the analysis; ChatGPT does the talking. Every figure comes from Reckon's stored analysis.

Read-only by design. Reckon never changes an ad account: it cannot pause an ad, move a budget or publish anything. Its only writes are to Reckon itself (logging a creative test, sending feedback, fetching a Meta Ad Library ad you share), and ChatGPT asks before each one.

Requires a Reckon workspace with a Meta or Google Ads account connected by an admin at usereckon.ai. Access is to the one workspace chosen at sign-in.
payload.longDescription:
广告仪表盘告诉你哪则广告胜出，Reckon告诉你原因。

Reckon会分析你在Meta和Google上投放的所有视频和图片，并标记其中内容：包括口头钩子、叙事角度、核心主张、内容形式、行动呼吁以及完整字幕。然后将这些元素与广告的投入和收益关联起来，你可以提问哪些钩子和角度真正促进销售，答案来自你自己的广告数据，而非通用准则。

Reckon同样会分析竞争对手。通过追踪你在Meta广告库中指定的品牌，以相同方式标记他们的广告，你可以看到他们采用而你未使用的角度，了解他们持续投放的广告，以及市场中哪些领域竞争激烈或存在空白。

你可以提出的问题包括：
- 哪些钩子、角度和形式在我们的广告中每结果成本最低？
- 我们表现最佳的广告有哪些共同点？观众在视频哪个环节流失？
- 竞争对手在强调什么而我们没有？请提供测试候选广告。
- 哪些广告需要停投或扩大规模？
每则广告都会与同产品竞品广告进行对比，每个行动呼吁都有数据支撑。

Meta和Google的数据会整合到单一报告中。无法直接相加的内容（如两种货币）会以命名方式呈现而非数值汇总。

Reckon负责数据分析，ChatGPT负责生成解释。所有数据均来自Reckon存储的分析结果。

设计为只读模式。Reckon不会修改任何广告账户：无法暂停广告、调整预算或发布内容。其唯一写入操作仅限于自身系统（如记录创意测试、发送反馈、获取你分享的Meta广告库广告），且每次操作前都会向ChatGPT确认。

需要拥有由usereckon.ai管理员连接的Meta或Google Ads账户的Reckon工作区。访问权限仅限于注册时选择的工作区。

payload.name: Orgvue EU
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Orgvue is the organizational design and workforce planning platform used by enterprises to model, cost and reshape their organizations. Connect OpenAI to Orgvue to explore workforce data, organizational structures, and planning scenarios.

In plain, natural language, ask questions about your workforce data: spans and layers, headcount by function, cost of a proposed structure, the gap between your current and future-state organization, or anything else you might want to know.

Ask workforce modelling questions and see the changes happening directly in Orgvue. You’ll get trusted answers grounded in your Orgvue data. See the impact of a scenario before you commit, draft the narrative for a restructure paper, or quickly pull the numbers you need for a board meeting.

Access follows your existing Orgvue permissions. OpenAI sees only the workspaces and datasets you're already entitled to, and only when you ask.

Orgvue remains the trusted source of workforce data and organizational scenarios, while OpenAI provides a conversational way to interact with them.

What you can do:

payload.longDescription:
Orgvue是企业用于组织设计和员工规划的平台，可对组织进行建模、成本核算和重塑。将OpenAI连接到Orgvue，以探索员工数据、组织结构和规划场景。

提出员工建模问题并直接在Orgvue中查看变化。您将获得基于您Orgvue数据的可信答案。在做出承诺前查看情景影响，起草重组方案的叙述，或快速提取董事会会议所需的数字。

访问权限遵循您现有的Orgvue权限。OpenAI仅能看到您已有权限的工作区和数据集，并且仅在您主动请求时可见。

payload.name: Docteur Bet

Docteur Bet将足球统计数据整合至ChatGPT。您可以询问某场比赛、联赛争冠形势或球队状态，系统将基于已发表的Dixon-Coles模型（Dixon & Coles, 1997）计算胜率，每轮赛后重新计算，覆盖21项赛事：英超、西甲、意甲、德甲、法甲、三个二级联赛、其他欧洲联赛、欧冠和欧联杯。

您可以查询：

• 联赛赛季预测：每支球队夺冠、获得欧战资格或降级概率，以及积分预测，基于数以万计的模拟赛季计算；
• 实力排名：哪些球队实际实力强于或弱于其联赛排名；

payload.name: RankZero

This plugin connects to your RankZero account so you can analyze that data in a conversation. Ask for a brand's visibility percentage and rank over the last 24 hours, 7, 30 or 90 days, see which competitors are mentioned alongside it, review recent AI answers to your tracked prompts, list the most-cited sources, and query the brand's connected Google Analytics 4 and Google Search Console data. The plugin only reads data and only sees the brands your RankZero account owns or shares through its organization. A RankZero account is required.
payload.longDescription:
RankZero可衡量品牌在AI搜索中的可见度——即当AI助手和AI搜索引擎回答客户问题时，它们提及该品牌的具体频率、品牌在竞争者中的排名情况，以及这些回答引用了哪些网站。
此插件可连接至您的RankZero账户，从而在对话中分析该数据。
您可以查询品牌在过去24小时、7天、30天或90天内的可见度百分比和排名，查看与品牌一同被提及的竞争者，查阅最近AI对跟踪提示的回答，列出被引用最多的来源，并查询品牌连接的Google Analytics 4和Google Search Console数据。

payload.name: Searcherries
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Searcherries gives your AI agent all the data it needs for GEO and SEO in one connection: how AI assistants answer your customers' questions about your market, plus your Google Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 data.

Connect Searcherries once and ask in plain language. The agent can build a prioritized action plan, find the questions where AI answers leave your brand out and see which competitors and sources they rely on instead, spot the pages and search queries with the most growth potential, and check how much traffic AI assistants send to your site and where it lands. When the agent can work with your website's code, the included skill turns these findings into concrete page changes and edits the files once you approve them.

Built for founders, marketers and SEO specialists who want their site recommended in AI answers and found in search.

Limitations: you need a Searcherries account with at least one project, and Search Console, Bing Webmaster Tools and GA4 data appear only for the sources you connect in Searcherries. Access is read-only: the plugin cannot change projects, questions or settings, and it returns the results of Searcherries' scheduled checks rather than running new ones. It only sees the projects of the account you authorize.
payload.longDescription:
Searcherries通过单一连接为您的AI代理提供GEO和SEO所需的所有数据：AI助手如何回答客户关于您所在市场的问题，以及您的Google搜索控制台、必应网页管理员工具和GA4数据。

只需连接一次Searcherries，即可用自然语言提问。
该代理可以制定优先行动方案，发现AI答案中遗漏品牌的问题，查看竞争对手和来源的依赖情况，识别具有最大增长潜力的页面和搜索查询，并检查AI助手为您网站带来的流量及流量来源页面。

payload.name: Hercules Real Estate Data
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Hercules Real Estate Data is a property research tool for real estate investors. It answers questions about properties, owners and investors in the United States, using public records and licensed property data, in plain language inside ChatGPT.

Use it to search property records nationwide, look up who owns a property, see who is behind an LLC, find NYC pre-foreclosures and distressed properties, and find active real estate investors and lenders in any market. It is built for investors, acquisitions teams, wholesalers, lenders and agents.

What you can do
- Property search and property records, anywhere in the United States: filter by city, county, zip code, property type, equity, absentee owners, vacant properties and more.
- Owner lookup: the owner of record, owner type, mailing address, how long they have owned it, and whether the property is owner-occupied or absentee-owned.
- Property details: estimated value and equity, mortgage and lender, last sale date, beds, baths, square footage and building details.
- NYC pre-foreclosure and foreclosure data: lis pendens filings by borough, foreclosure stage, equity, filing age and recently added cases.
- LLC owner lookup: find the officers, managers and registered agent behind an LLC or company that owns property, from public business filings.
- Active investors: see who is buying in an area, including cash buyers, portfolio owners and corporate buyers, grouped by owner with recent purchase counts.
- Investor and lender firm search: hard money lenders, private lenders, note buyers, fix-and-flip investors, real estate funds and wholesalers, with business phone numbers, business emails and websites.

Before a large search runs, you see how many records match and get suggestions for narrowing it. Nothing runs until you confirm.

What it does not do
- It does not provide personal phone numbers or personal email addresses.
- It covers properties in the United States only.
- A Hercules account is required.

Try asking
- "Find absentee-owned single-family homes in Tampa with at least 40% equity."
- "Show me NYC pre-foreclosures in Brooklyn added in the last 30 days."
- "Who owns 123 Main Street in Austin, Texas?"
- "Who is behind Lennar Homes, LLC in Florida?"
- "Who is buying multifamily properties in Miami?"
- "Find hard money lenders in Phoenix."

Results are provided for research and may be incomplete or out of date. Verify before relying on them. See the privacy policy and terms for details.
payload.longDescription:
Hercules Real Estate Data是房地产投资者的房产研究工具。它通过ChatGPT以自然语言回答美国房产、所有者和投资者相关问题，数据来源包括公开记录和授权房产数据。

您可以 nationwide 搜索房产记录，查询房产所有者信息，查看LLC背后的公司实体，查找纽约市预法拍房和 distressed properties（困境房产），以及发现任何市场中的活跃房地产投资者和贷款机构。该工具专为投资者、收购团队、二手房商、贷款机构和经纪人设计。

您可以实现的功能包括
- 全美范围的房产搜索与记录查询：支持按城市、县、邮编、房产类型、净值、非居住所有者、空置房产等条件筛选。
- 所有者信息查询：记录所有者类型、邮寄地址、持有时长，以及房产是否为自住或非居住所有。
- 房产详情：预估价值与净值、抵押贷款及贷款机构、最近售出日期、房间数、浴室数、建筑面积和建筑详情。
- 纽约市预法拍与法拍数据：按行政区划分的诉讼中文件（lis pendens）记录、法拍阶段、净值、文件年龄和近期新增案件。
- LLC所有者信息查询：通过公开企业文件，查找拥有房产的LLC或公司的高管、管理人员和注册代理人。
- 活跃投资者信息：查看某个区域的买家信息，包括现金买家、组合持有者和企业买家，按所有者分组显示最近购买次数。
- 投资者与贷款机构搜索：提供硬钱贷款机构、私人贷款商、票据买家、翻新投资者、房地产基金和二手房商信息，包含企业电话、企业邮箱和官网链接。

在执行大型搜索前，您会看到匹配的记录数量，并获得缩小范围的建议。在您确认前不会执行任何操作。

该工具不提供以下内容
- 不提供个人电话号码或个人电子邮件地址。
- 仅覆盖美国境内的房产。
- 需要Hercules账户才能使用。

可以尝试提问
- "查找坦帕市至少40%净值的非居住独栋住宅。"
- "显示最近30天新增的布鲁克林区纽约市预法拍房。"
- "谁拥有德克萨斯州奥斯汀市123 Main Street的房产？"
- "佛罗里达州Lennar Homes, LLC背后的公司实体是谁？"
- "谁在迈阿密购买多户住宅？"
- "查找凤凰城的硬钱贷款机构。"

查询结果仅用于研究目的，可能不完整或已过时。在依赖结果前请自行核实。详情请查看隐私政策和使用条款。

payload.name: Jet Tracker
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Jet Tracker brings Brazilian business aviation data into ChatGPT. Ask about any Brazilian-registered aircraft and get the official registry record (RAB/ANAC), the owner set with the company record from the Receita Federal, airworthiness validity, tracked flight activity (ADS-B/FR24), overnight base, market listings and certified maintenance shops (ANAC RBAC 145), with US (FAA) and worldwide (GAMA) context.

payload.name: Home

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
