Describe what you want in your own words: a town, city or postcode, buying or renting, your budget, how many bedrooms, new build or not, newest or lowest price first, and what you want in the home itself, such as a garden, off-road parking, a quiet street, period features, open-plan living, a home office or no onward chain. Home shows the matching houses and flats as photo cards and a map, with asking price or rent, bedrooms, tenure, the date each one was added, how long it has been on the market, whether it has been reduced or gone under offer, and the listing's own words for each feature you asked about.

Open any result for the full picture in chat: every photo, the complete description, the agent, key facts and, where the published address can be matched to a property, checks from Homedata such as the EPC energy rating, council tax band, flood and other environmental risks, broadband, nearby schools and recorded crime. Keep a shortlist and compare two to four homes side by side. See which homes are within a walk, cycle or drive of a station, office, school or postcode, and put up to six viewings in the quickest driving order for the day. Ask what an area is like for schools, broadband, recorded crime and local house price growth, see recent sold prices and typical rents nearby, find local estate and letting agents, and estimate stamp duty or monthly mortgage repayments from your own figures.

Home also brings five workflows: what can I afford, turning a monthly budget and deposit into a price and the homes at it; prepare for a viewing, with a checklist and questions for the agent built from the home's own details; plan a viewing day, with the order, the driving between stops and what to ask at each; shortlist and compare, ranking homes against what matters to you, commute included; and buying costs, setting out stamp duty, deposit, loan and monthly repayments together.

It is for anyone house hunting: first-time buyers, movers, renters and families comparing places to live. Searching, viewing property details, comparing homes and using the planning and calculator tools need no account.

Limitations: Home does not value homes or forecast prices, list a home, contact agents for you, or decide mortgage eligibility. Calculator results are estimates, not tax or financial advice, and stamp duty covers England and Northern Ireland. Commute and driving times are typical estimates, not timetables or live traffic. Availability and status are snapshots from the time of the search.
payload.longDescription:
Home在对话中直接从home.co.uk提供全英范围内的房产出售和租赁信息。用您自己的话描述需求：城市、城镇或邮编，购房或租房，预算范围，房间数量，是否新房，按最新上架或最低价格排序，以及您关注的房屋特征，例如带花园、户外停车、安静街道、历史建筑特色、开放式布局、家庭办公室或无后续交易链。Home以图文卡片和地图形式展示匹配的房源，显示报价或租金、房间数、产权类型、上架日期、挂牌时长、是否降价或已报价，以及房源详情中与您需求相关的各项特征描述。

点击任意结果查看完整房源信息：所有照片、完整描述、中介信息、关键数据，当发布地址可匹配具体房产时，还可查看Homedata提供的检查信息，包括能源效率评级、市政税等级、洪水及其他环境风险、宽带速度、周边学校和犯罪记录。可创建精选列表并同时对比2-4处房产。查看哪些房源位于车站、办公室、学校或邮编区域的步行、骑行或驾车范围内，并按最快驾驶顺序安排最多6次看房。询问某个区域的学校、宽带、犯罪记录及房价增长情况，查看周边近期成交价和典型租金，查找当地房产和租赁中介，并根据自身数据估算印花税或月供还款额。

Home提供五大工作流：1）我负担得起什么：将月预算和首付转换为可购房价及对应房源；2）看房准备：根据房源信息自动生成检查清单和中介提问指南；3）看房日规划：包含行程顺序、各站点间驾驶路线及每个房源的提问清单；4）精选对比：根据您关注的要素（含通勤时间）对房源进行排序；5）购房成本：整合展示印花税、首付、贷款及月供还款明细。

Home适用于所有寻房人群：首次购房者、搬迁者、租房者及对比居住地的家庭。搜索、查看房源详情、对比房产及使用规划和计算器工具均无需账户。

限制条件：Home不提供房产估值或价格预测，不发布房源，不代您联系中介，也不判定房贷资格。计算器结果为估算值，不构成税务或财务建议，印花税仅适用于英格兰和北爱尔兰。通勤及驾驶时间均为常规预估，非时刻表或实时路况。可用性和状态仅为搜索时的快照信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search UK homes for sale and to rent, Search by garden, parking, quiet street and more, Every photo and the full description of a home, Time on market, price reductions and under-offer dates, Compare two to four homes side by side, Homes within a walk, cycle or drive of a place, Plan the quickest order for a day of viewings, Area checks: schools, broadband, crime, price growth, Stamp duty, mortgage and affordability estimates

payload.name: Perigon
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Perigon helps analysts and researchers search, filter and analyze global news data. Search articles and stories by sentiment, journalist, publisher location, company, topic, language and date. Combine filters to find precise coverage, compare trends and produce briefings with source citations.

Create monitors that track matching news and extract structured fields for analysis. Example requests:
• Create a monitor for AI startups raising a Series A. Extract funding value, industry, funding type and status.
• Create a monitor for mentions of my brand in Perigon news coverage, with a sentiment breakdown.
• Create a monitor for cybersecurity incidents in the financial sector. Extract severity, incident type, data exposure and affected companies.

Explore monitor events and newsletters, then analyze results with Signal Insights exports and charts. New monitors default to drafts unless you ask to activate them. Brand monitoring requires your brand name and any relevant aliases; coverage depends on available sources and your filters.

Connect your Perigon account through OAuth. Available tools and data depend on your organization permissions.
payload.longDescription:
Perigon帮助分析师和研究人员搜索、过滤并分析全球新闻数据。通过情感、记者、发布者所在地区、公司、主题、语言和日期等条件搜索文章和新闻故事。组合筛选条件以找到精确的报道，对比趋势并生成带来源引用的简报。

创建可追踪匹配新闻的监控项，并提取结构化字段用于分析。示例请求：• 为获得A轮融资的AI初创公司创建监控项，提取融资金额、行业、融资类型和状态。• 为Perigon新闻报道中提及的品牌创建监控项，并提供情感分析。• 为金融行业的网络安全事件创建监控项，提取严重程度、事件类型、数据泄露情况和受影响公司。

查看监控事件和新闻简报，然后通过Signal Insights导出数据和图表分析结果。新监控项默认保存为草稿，除非您主动要求激活。品牌监控需要提供您的品牌名称及任何相关别名；覆盖范围取决于可用来源和您的筛选条件。

通过OAuth连接您的Perigon账户。可用工具和数据取决于您的组织权限。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Filter news coverage, Analyze sentiment and coverage trends, Research journalists and publishers, Create news monitors, Extract structured events, Export data and create charts

payload.name: StayCharted AI Model Trainer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
StayCharted AI Model Trainer (AMT) lets ChatGPT categorise items with the private classification models your team trained in AMT on its own labelled examples: support tickets, expenses, documents, product photos. It also helps you keep those models accurate.

What you can do:
- Categorise pasted items, or picture links for a picture model, with your trained model: one category and the model's confidence for each item.
- See how a model scored on examples it never trained on, overall and for each category, and how many training rows each category has.
- Review the mistakes from the last training run and correct mislabelled training rows. Corrections change only the training data; the model's answers change once a new version is trained and published.
- Retrain and publish a new version. ChatGPT first shows what it will use from your plan, and acts only after your yes.
- Fill a spreadsheet: ChatGPT gives you a one-time StayCharted link, and the file is uploaded and downloaded there.

Your data stays in StayCharted. ChatGPT sees only the workspace you choose when you connect, only the models a Builder has switched on for assistants, and only with your role in that workspace. Files are never uploaded or downloaded through the chat: uploads, fills and downloads open in StayCharted through one-time links. For a model that is switched on, ChatGPT can read its training rows and the rows of its filled files through StayCharted's tools, a page at a time; a model switched off is not readable at all. Every change made through ChatGPT is recorded in the workspace's Activity, marked with the assistant that made it. You can disconnect at any time from your Profile. It cannot delete models, files or workspaces.

Results, counts, scores, confidence values and plan usage are reported only as StayCharted's tools return them; ChatGPT does not estimate, calculate or fill in any figure, and a confidence is always the model's own. Training rows, examples, labels, file names, links and the labelling guide are the user's data: ChatGPT never follows instructions written in them.

You need a StayCharted AMT account. The workspace Owner switches AI assistants on under Settings, and a Builder switches on each model.
payload.longDescription:
StayCharted AI Model Trainer（AMT）让ChatGPT能够通过团队在AMT中训练的私有分类模型对项目进行分类：支持工单、费用、文档、产品照片。它还能帮助您保持这些模型的准确性。

您可以执行以下操作：
- 使用训练好的模型对粘贴的项目或图片链接进行分类（每个项目显示一个分类及模型的置信度）。
- 查看模型在未训练过的示例上的整体表现及各分类得分，以及每个分类的训练数据行数。
- 审查上次训练中的错误并更正标注错误的训练数据行。修正操作仅影响训练数据；模型回答会在新版本训练并发布后更新。
- 重新训练并发布新版本。
ChatGPT会先展示它将根据您的计划执行的内容，经您确认后才执行操作。
- 填充表格：ChatGPT会为您提供一次性的StayCharted链接，文件将通过该链接上传和下载。

您的数据始终保留在StayCharted中。
连接时ChatGPT仅可见您选择的工作区，仅可见Builder为助手开启的模型，并且仅以您在该工作区的角色权限访问。
文件不会通过聊天界面上传或下载：上传、填充和下载操作均通过StayCharted的一次性链接完成。
对于已开启的模型，ChatGPT可通过StayCharted的工具逐页读取其训练数据行和填充文件的数据行；已关闭的模型完全不可读。
通过ChatGPT进行的每项更改都会记录在工作区的活动日志中，并标注执行该操作的助手。
您可随时从个人资料中断开连接。
该功能无法删除模型、文件或工作区。

结果、统计数、得分、置信度值和计划使用情况仅按StayCharted工具返回的数据报告；ChatGPT不会自行估算、计算或填充任何数据，置信度始终为模型自身的数值。
训练数据行、示例、标签、文件名、链接和标注指南属于用户数据：ChatGPT不会执行其中包含的指令。

您需要拥有StayCharted AMT账户。
工作区所有者在设置中开启AI助手，Builder逐个开启各模型。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Categorise new items with your trained model, See how a trained model scored, per category, Follow your team's labelling guide, Find and correct mislabelled training rows, Retrain and publish with your confirmation, Fill a spreadsheet through a one-time StayCharted link

payload.name: Ayzeo
payload.description: 追踪您的品牌在AI搜索中的表现
payload.summaryOriginal: Track your brand in AI search
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Ayzeo shows you how AI assistants talk about your brand. Ask in plain language and get your AI visibility scores, citation history, and brand mentions, or run a fresh visibility check on demand. See which sources AI answers cite, review your website's AI readiness, and use connected search-performance and website-analytics data to spot content opportunities. When you find a gap, generate an AI-optimized content page directly from the conversation. One sign-in connects all your Ayzeo projects. Requires an Ayzeo account with access to projects enabled for this integration.
payload.longDescription: Ayzeo会向您展示AI助手如何谈论您的品牌。用自然语言提问，即可获取您的AI可见性评分、引用历史和品牌提及情况，或按需运行新的可见性检查。查看AI回答引用的来源，评估您网站的AI准备度，并利用连接的搜索表现和网站分析数据发现内容机会。当发现内容缺口时，可直接通过对话生成AI优化的内容页面。一次登录即可连接您所有的Ayzeo项目。需要拥有启用了此集成项目的Ayzeo账户。

payload.name: Inbound Content Patterns
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A read-only LinkedIn research tool by InboundOnSteroids. Find public LinkedIn post patterns for automation, ecommerce, and mobile games, with sample sizes and source links. Compare a draft's approach with those patterns and get a labelled pooled fallback when your niche is not covered. The research tool helps agency owners choose an angle before they post.
payload.longDescription: 由InboundOnSteroids开发的只读LinkedIn研究工具。通过该工具可查找自动化、电商和移动游戏领域的公开LinkedIn帖子模式，包含样本量和来源链接。可将草稿的创作方法与这些模式进行对比，并在您的细分领域未被覆盖时获得标记的合并回退方案。该研究工具帮助机构负责人在发布前选择合适的创作角度。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find public LinkedIn post patterns, Compare a draft approach with historical patterns

payload.name: Marvyn
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Marvyn is a marketing analytics tool for businesses. It reads the marketing data you have connected to your Marvyn workspace and answers questions about it with numbers Marvyn has already calculated.

What you can ask: how your marketing is doing overall; which ad campaigns and ads are working or wasting money (Meta, Google, LinkedIn, Snapchat and Reddit ads); where your website funnel loses people; whether your conversion tracking can be trusted; why a number changed; and what to fix first.

Data sources: ad accounts, website analytics (GA4), Google Search Console, Facebook and Instagram, and Shopify.

Reliability: every answer says how fresh the data is, which sources are missing, and which figures were withheld because there was not enough data behind them. Marvyn says "not enough data" rather than guessing.

Without an account: check whether AI crawlers can read any website (robots.txt rules for AI crawlers, llms.txt, sitemap and home page).

Who it is for: founders, marketers and agencies who use Marvyn (marvyn.io). Connecting uses your existing Marvyn account, and available features follow your Marvyn plan.

Limitations: read-only. Marvyn cannot change, pause, publish or spend anything, and reads only the one Marvyn workspace you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Marvyn是面向企业的营销分析工具。它会读取您连接到Marvyn工作区的营销数据，并通过已计算的数字回答有关数据的问题。

您可以询问：营销整体表现如何；哪些广告活动和广告在产生效果或浪费资金（支持Meta、Google、LinkedIn、Snapchat和Reddit广告）；网站漏斗在哪一环节流失用户；转化跟踪是否可信；某个数值变化的原因；以及优先需要解决的问题。

数据源包括广告账户、网站分析（GA4）、Google搜索控制台、Facebook和Instagram，以及Shopify。

可靠性说明：每个回答会注明数据新鲜度、缺失的数据源，以及因数据不足而被隐藏的数值。Marvyn会明确提示「数据不足」而非进行猜测。

未开通账户时：可检查AI爬虫是否能读取任意网站（需符合AI爬虫的robots.txt规则、llms.txt、站点地图和首页规范）。

适用对象：使用Marvyn（marvyn.io）的创始人、营销人员和代理商。连接需使用现有Marvyn账户，可用功能取决于您的Marvyn计划。

使用限制：仅支持只读模式。Marvyn无法更改、暂停、发布或支出任何内容，且仅读取您连接的单一Marvyn工作区。

payload.name: Isoligne
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Isoligne gives ChatGPT verified, dated data about French companies, measured or published at the source.

- Website analytics: the published Agent Readiness Score of a company website (how much of it an AI assistant can read and understand), axis by axis, with its date and method; what lowers it; and which buying questions none of its pages answer.
- Sector benchmarks: how the published websites of a sector rank (insurance, wine, energy, higher education, training, e-commerce, software).
- Price data: the exact price of a specific case (quantities, options, period), calculated line by line on the price grid a company publishes with Isoligne, with its source and date. A missing quantity is never guessed: the answer says which one to provide.

Read-only, no account, no key. Only published data is served: a domain absent from the index has not been measured or published, which says nothing about its quality. Answers are in French.
payload.longDescription:
Isoligne为ChatGPT提供关于法国公司的经过验证、带日期的数据，这些数据在源头进行测量或发布。

- 网站分析：公司网站的已发布AI助手准备度评分（AI助手能读取和理解的内容比例），按轴分析，包含日期和方法；降低评分的因素；以及其页面均未解答的购买问题
- 行业基准：各行业（保险、葡萄酒、能源、高等教育、培训、电子商务、软件）已发布网站的排名情况
- 价格数据：特定案例（数量、选项、时段）的精确价格，按公司通过Isoligne发布的定价表逐行计算，包含来源和日期。若缺少数量信息不会进行推测：回答会明确提示需要提供该项数据。

只读模式，无需账户，无需密钥。仅提供已发布数据：若域名未出现在索引中，表示该域名未被测量或发布，这与网站质量无关。所有回答均使用法语。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Look up the published AI readability score of a company website, Explain what lowers a website's score, with measured evidence, Benchmark the published websites of a sector, Calculate an exact price on a company's published price grid

payload.name: Mukscan Food Facts
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mukscan Food Facts looks up the official label data of Korean packaged foods: nutrition facts, ingredients, allergen labeling and HACCP status for about 320,000 products registered with Korea's Ministry of Food and Drug Safety.

Ask about a snack, ramen, drink or sauce from a Korean store and get the numbers from government records instead of a guess. For example: how much sodium is in one bag of Saeukkang (새우깡), or how Shin Ramyun and Jin Ramen compare per 100g.

What it does
- Searches products by Korean name, optionally narrowed by manufacturer
- Shows nutrition facts (up to 15 nutrients) per 100g or 100ml and per package, the ingredient list when available, allergen labeling as recorded, and the data reference date
- Compares 2 to 5 products side by side per 100g

What it does not do
- No prices, stores, purchase links or ads
- No health judgments or diet advice
- No "safe to eat" verdicts on allergens. Allergen data exists for about 4.6% of products, and missing data does not mean a product is allergen-free. Always check the package label.

Data comes from Korean government open data (Ministry of Food and Drug Safety; Korea Agency of HACCP Accreditation and Services), published under KOGL Type 1. Every answer carries the source and the data reference date. Read-only, no account needed.

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search Korean food products by name, Show nutrition facts, ingredients and allergen labeling, Compare 2 to 5 products per 100g

payload.name: Handler
payload.description: 为您的应用找到TikTok上的成功内容
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Handler finds the TikToks beating their own account's average in your niche and breaks down why each one worked. Connect it and ChatGPT can read your Handler research library, so you can ask for this week's winners, look up a competitor's account, or turn a breakdown into a script without switching tabs.

What ChatGPT can do with Handler:
- Find winners for your app's niche, or across every industry, filtered by format (talking head, silent UGC, app demo, slideshow and more). Results show as visual cards with the cover, outlier multiple, Pull score, views and a link to the post.
- Explain any post: its outlier and Pull scores, why it works, what it sells, and what the comments say.
- Search your research library, and open your saved posts and collections.
- List your AI creators and check the status of your renders.

Who it is for: mobile app founders and marketers who grow their app with TikTok and UGC.

Limits: everything is read-only. Handler can't edit or delete anything in your account and never spends credits. Media files are not returned, only covers and links back to Handler.
payload.longDescription:
Handler会寻找您领域内表现优于自身账号平均值的TikTok内容，并解析每条内容成功的原因。连接后，ChatGPT可访问您的Handler研究资料库，您可询问本周爆款内容、查询竞争对手账号或直接将解析结果转化为脚本而无需切换标签页。

ChatGPT与Handler的协作功能：
- 按格式（口播视频、静音用户生成内容、应用演示、幻灯片等）筛选您应用领域或全行业的爆款内容。结果以包含封面图、异常值倍数、Pull评分、播放量及原文链接的可视化卡片形式展示。
- 解析任意内容：显示其异常值评分与Pull评分、成功要素、产品卖点及评论区反馈。
- 搜索您的研究资料库，打开保存的帖子与收藏集。
- 列出您的AI创作者名单，并查看渲染进度状态。

适用对象：通过TikTok和用户生成内容增长应用的移动应用创始人及营销人员。

使用限制：所有操作均为只读模式。
Handler无法编辑或删除您账户中的任何内容，且永远不会消耗信用点。
媒体文件不会被返回，仅提供封面图及跳转至Handler的链接。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Find outlier TikToks winning in your app's niche or across every industry, Explain why a post worked: scores, hook, format and comment read, Search your Handler research library and saved collections, List your AI creators and check render status, Show results as visual cards with links back to Handler

payload.name: Machine Relations Index
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research which sources appear in AI-generated answers using measured citation data. Find ranked domains by buyer category and question type, filter for editorial publications or vendor sites, and look up a domain’s observed citations. Compare sources to inform research and content planning. Results include release windows, sample counts and source links. Read-only access to public Machine Relations Index data; no account required. Data is licensed under CC BY 4.0.
payload.longDescription: 通过测量引用数据，研究哪些来源出现在AI生成的答案中。按买家类别和问题类型查找排名域名，筛选编辑类出版物或供应商网站，并查询某个域名的引用数据。比较不同来源以指导研究和内容规划。结果包含发布窗口、样本数量及来源链接。提供公共机器关系指数数据的只读访问，无需账户。数据遵循CC BY 4.0许可。

payload.name: Rankability
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Analyze SEO and AI visibility data for your clients in Rankability. Review saved rankings, AI mentions and citations, page audits, keyword research, and content projects to prioritize improvements. Research, content creation, scans, and other changes require the appropriate account permissions and your authorization. Access stays within the organization you connect.
payload.longDescription:
在Rankability中分析客户的SEO和AI可见性数据。
查看保存的排名、AI提及和引用、页面审计、关键词研究和内容项目，以确定改进优先级。
研究、内容创作、扫描和其他更改需要适当的账户权限和您的授权。
访问权限仅限于您连接的组织。

payload.name: OneLence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
OneLence is a marketing analytics and growth workspace for small teams. It brings together your website journeys and conversions, ad platforms, search, AI search visibility and affiliate partners, and tells you what deserves attention, what to do about it and how sure it is, even when attribution is incomplete.

Ask for today's priorities and which channels and partners to scale, hold or stop, with the reasons and evidence behind each Decision. See how AI search engines read your site, which search pages to improve first, which affiliates actually convert and which new partners are worth a look. Compare periods, check which bots and crawlers visit, or log a budget change and let OneLence watch what follows. In a codebase, the plugin installs OneLence tracking and verifies that events arrive.

Nothing changes without your confirmation, and OneLence never touches your ad accounts or moves money. Requires a OneLence account.
payload.longDescription:
OneLence是面向小型团队的营销分析与增长工作区，整合您的网站旅程与转化数据、广告平台、搜索数据、AI搜索可见性及联盟合作伙伴，帮助您识别需要关注的内容，明确应对策略并评估执行确定性，即使在归因不完整时也能提供有效洞察

可查询今日优先事项及需扩大、保持或终止的渠道与合作伙伴，并获取每个决策背后的理由与依据。查看AI搜索引擎如何抓取您的网站，优先优化哪些搜索页面，哪些联盟合作伙伴真正带来转化，以及哪些新合作伙伴值得尝试。对比不同时期数据，查看访问的爬虫与机器人，或记录预算变更后让OneLence追踪后续变化。在代码库中，插件可安装OneLence追踪代码并验证事件是否正常到达

所有变更均需您确认，OneLence不会直接操作您的广告账户或资金。需要拥有OneLence账户

payload.name: StrengthLog
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: StrengthLog helps you analyze the strength-training data you have logged in your StrengthLog account. Summarize workouts over a date range, inspect individual sessions and sets, review personal records, and retrieve logged body measurements. Filter workout history and summaries by exercise using English or Swedish exercise names. Sign in with your StrengthLog account to explore your own training history in conversation. The connection provides read-only access and cannot create, modify, or delete workouts or other account data.
payload.longDescription:
StrengthLog可帮助您分析在StrengthLog账户中记录的力量训练数据。
在指定日期范围内总结训练内容，检查单次训练和组数，查看个人最佳记录，并获取已记录的身体测量数据。
可通过使用英文或瑞典语的练习名称筛选训练历史记录和摘要。
通过StrengthLog账户登录，即可以对话方式探索您的训练历史。
该连接仅提供只读访问权限，无法创建、修改或删除训练计划或其他账户数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Summarize training history, View workout sessions and sets, View personal records, View body measurements

payload.name: GovBot Organization Records
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Research organizations using official public agency APIs from SEC EDGAR, USAspending.gov, EPA ECHO, CFPB, FDA and NHTSA within their published access limits. The service brings SEC and USAspending identity candidates into one workflow, normalizes selected record fields, and labels sources, retrieval dates, record periods and match basis where supplied. Skills guide entity selection, distinguish annual obligations from life-of-award amounts, and qualify name-matched enforcement, complaint and recall records. Prepare sourced organization profiles, contracting histories and supplier background briefs. Coverage and availability vary; name matches may concern unrelated entities. Complaints do not establish wrongdoing and empty searches do not prove compliance. No risk scores or legal, eligibility or compliance determinations. No sign-in required. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency or OpenAI.
payload.longDescription: 通过官方公共机构API研究组织，包括SEC EDGAR、USAspending.gov、EPA ECHO、CFPB、FDA和NHTSA，在其公开的访问限制内。该服务将SEC和USAspending的身份候选对象整合到一个工作流中，标准化选定的记录字段，并标注来源、检索日期、记录期间和匹配依据（如提供）。功能可指导实体选择，区分年度义务与奖项生命周期金额，并验证名称匹配的执法、投诉和召回记录。生成来源组织的简介、合同历史和供应商背景简报。覆盖范围和可用性可能有所不同；名称匹配可能涉及不相关实体。投诉并不证明存在不当行为，而空搜索结果也不证明合规性。不提供风险评分或法律、资格或合规性判断。无需登录。与任何政府机构或OpenAI无关联或未被其认可。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Organization identity resolution, Sourced federal-record profiles, Federal award history, Qualified supplier background briefs

payload.name: TerraLab
payload.description: 地图数据，已准备好用于QGIS
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TerraLab gets map data into QGIS from a conversation. Ask for buildings, roads, addresses, land use, waterways, transit stops or protected areas around any place, see them on an interactive map with a street or aerial view, and download them as Shapefile, GeoJSON, KML or CSV that open directly in QGIS. Data comes from Overture Maps and OpenStreetMap.

Convert files and coordinates: open a GeoJSON, KML, KMZ, GPX, zipped Shapefile, CSV or WKT file, check it on a map and convert it. Convert coordinates between decimal degrees, DMS, UTM, MGRS, Lambert 93 and EPSG codes, with the recommended local CRS for your project. Put a single place or a list of up to 100 addresses on a map and export the points.

Terrain: elevations, profiles and contour lines anywhere in the world from Copernicus DEM. In France, find the cadastral parcel and the local urban plan (PLU) zone at an address, from the official cadastre and Géoportail de l'Urbanisme open data; owner names and sale prices are never returned.

No account or sign-in is needed. Every answer names its sources and licences (OpenStreetMap, Overture Maps, Copernicus DEM, ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2 imagery, IGN and DGFiP open data), and every download includes its licence. Limits: extracts up to 20,000 features and 200 km² for buildings (larger for other layers), contour lines up to about 10 x 10 km, files up to 50 MB and lists up to 100 addresses. Elevation comes from a 30 m surface model that includes buildings and trees. Results are approximate and not for navigation, surveying or legal boundaries.
payload.longDescription:
TerraLab通过对话将地图数据导入QGIS。
可请求任意地点的建筑物、道路、地址、土地利用、水系、交通站点或保护区数据，以街道或航拍视图在交互式地图上查看，并下载为可直接在QGIS中打开的Shapefile、GeoJSON、KML或CSV格式。
数据来源于Overture Maps和OpenStreetMap。

文件与坐标转换：打开GeoJSON、KML、KMZ、GPX、压缩的Shapefile、CSV或WKT文件，在地图上查看并转换文件。
在十进制度数、DMS、UTM、MGRS、Lambert 93和EPSG代码之间转换坐标，并获取项目推荐的本地坐标参考系统（CRS）。
将单个地点或最多100个地址的列表放在地图上并导出这些点。

地形数据：从Copernicus DEM获取全球任意地点的高程、剖面和等高线。
在法国，可通过官方地籍数据和Géoportail de l'Urbanisme开放数据，查询地址对应的土地登记地块和城市规划区（PLU）分区；不会返回业主姓名和售价。

无需账户或登录。
每个回答都会标注数据来源及许可协议（OpenStreetMap、Overture Maps、Copernicus DEM、ESA WorldCover Sentinel-2影像、IGN和DGFiP开放数据），每次下载均包含对应许可协议。
使用限制：建筑物数据提取上限为20,000个要素和200平方公里（其他图层更大），等高线约10×10平方公里，文件上限50MB，地址列表上限100条。
高程数据来源于包含建筑物和树木的30米分辨率地表模型。
结果为近似值，不适用于导航、测绘或法律边界。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Open data extracts for QGIS, Open and convert GIS files, Convert coordinates and pick a CRS, Places and address lists on a map, Elevation, profiles and contours, French parcels and zoning

payload.name: Mirror Panel
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Test headlines, product claims, and other written marketing ideas with simulated consumers. Compare ratings and answers from A/B comparisons, rankings, and qualitative studies. Review existing studies, individual responses, study size limits, and remaining allowance. The consumers are AI-generated profiles; this app does not test images or videos.
payload.longDescription: 通过模拟消费者测试标题、产品宣传语和其他书面营销方案，对比A/B测试、排名和定性研究中的评分与回答，查看现有研究、单个回复、研究规模限制及剩余配额。该应用的消费者为AI生成的虚拟资料，不支持图片或视频测试。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Test written ideas, Review study results, Read individual answers

payload.name: ActivTrak MCP
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
ActivTrak MCP connects ChatGPT to your workforce data, so you can just ask what you want to know instead of digging through dashboards or exporting spreadsheets.

Ask things like "which teams are closest to burnout this quarter" or "do we have capacity to take on the new product rollout" and get a real answer, not a chart you have to interpret yourself.
payload.longDescription:
ActivTrak MCP将ChatGPT与您的员工数据连接，您只需直接提问所需信息，而无需手动浏览仪表盘或导出电子表格。

您可以询问「哪些团队本季度最接近倦怠」或「我们是否有能力接手新产品发布」等问题，获得真实答案，而非需要自行解读的图表。

payload.name: PDFHost
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: PDFHost gives teams permanent PDF links, website embeds, QR codes, and document analytics. Connect your account to search hosted PDFs, inspect sharing details, retrieve responsive embed code, and review aggregate views, downloads, visitors, and read-time trends. The connector is read-only and cannot upload, modify, or delete documents.
payload.longDescription: PDFHost为团队提供永久PDF链接、网站嵌入代码、二维码和文档分析数据。连接您的账户可搜索托管的PDF文件，查看共享详情，获取响应式嵌入代码，并查阅汇总的浏览量、下载量、访客数和阅读时间趋势。该连接器为只读模式，无法上传、修改或删除文档。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: PDF document search, Document analytics, Share-link details, Embed code

payload.name: Workopia Hiring Intelligence
payload.description: 招聘与劳动力市场数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Analyze hiring demand using Workopia's observed job-posting data. Explore country hiring overviews, daily or weekly trends for a city, company hiring snapshots, published rankings of frontier AI labs, Y Combinator companies and Fortune 500 companies, and published country labour-market reports.

Results include source dates and available measurement windows. They describe advertised hiring demand, not completed hires, total employment or official labour-force statistics. Coverage varies by location, company and period.

Use this plugin for aggregate hiring research and published reports. It does not search or apply to individual jobs, write resumes or cover letters, or change accounts.
payload.longDescription:
通过Workopia的观察到的职位发布数据，分析招聘需求。探索国家招聘概览、城市每日或每周趋势、公司招聘快照、前沿AI实验室、Y Combinator企业及财富500强企业的已发布排名，以及国家劳动力市场报告。

结果包含数据来源日期和可用时间段，仅描述广告招聘需求，而非已完成的招聘、总就业人数或官方劳动力统计数据，覆盖范围因地区、公司和时间段而异。

本插件适用于汇总招聘研究和已发布报告，不搜索或申请单个职位，不撰写简历或求职信，也不更改账户。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Country hiring overview, City hiring trends, Company hiring snapshot, Published hiring rankings, Published labour-market reports

payload.name: GovIntelligence
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Bring GovIntelligence into your conversations. Connect once with your GovIntelligence login, then ask the questions you would otherwise answer by clicking through the website.

Find the tenders that matter to you: IT tenders in Bavaria above a certain value, awards in the cloud segment over the last two years, contracts of a key account that expire this year. GovIntelligence searches, filters the results and summarises what it finds.

Ask for a market picture: how big a segment is, who the leading buyers and vendors are, how activity has developed over time. Ask about a single organization: what it buys or wins, with whom, and what it has published recently. Ask about a specific contract: who holds it today, who else competes for similar work, and what related tenders exist.

Every answer comes with a link to the matching page on GovIntelligence, so you can open the full view, check the numbers and continue your work there. Your organization folders and saved feeds are available as filters, so the assistant can focus on the accounts your team is already tracking, and with your permission it can create and update those folders and feeds for you.

Procurement data is never changed. The assistant sees exactly what you see when you are logged in, nothing more, and you can disconnect it at any time from your account settings.

Requires an active GovIntelligence account.
payload.longDescription:
将GovIntelligence带入您的对话中。通过一次GovIntelligence登录连接，然后提出您原本需要通过点击网站页面来回答的问题。

找到对您重要的招标信息：巴伐利亚州价值超过一定数额的IT招标，过去两年云领域奖项，关键客户今年到期的合同。GovIntelligence会搜索、筛选结果并总结发现内容。

询问市场概况：该领域规模多大，主要买家和供应商是谁，活动量如何随时间变化。询问单个组织：它采购或中标情况，合作方是谁，最近发布了什么。询问具体合同：当前持有方是谁，还有哪些竞争者，是否存在相关招标。

每个答案都附带指向GovIntelligence对应页面的链接，您可以打开完整视图核对数据并继续操作。您的组织文件夹和已保存的订阅源可作为筛选条件，这样助手能专注您团队已跟踪的客户，经您授权后还能为您创建和更新这些文件夹与订阅源。

采购数据永不更改。助手看到的内容与您登录时完全一致，不多于您看到的内容，您可随时从账户设置中断开连接。

需要有效的GovIntelligence账户。

payload.name: Bikky
payload.description: 分析您的销售数据和顾客信息
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Sales tells you what happened. Bikky tells you why.

Bikky is the customer data platform built exclusively for multi-unit restaurants. It brings your POS, online ordering, and loyalty data together into guest profiles, so you can see how every marketing, menu, and operational decision lands with your guests.

This plugin brings that data into ChatGPT. Ask a question the way you would ask an analyst, and get an answer from your own brand's data—no spreadsheets, dashboards, or filters required.

Ask about sales, average check, and traffic by daypart or by store. Ask which menu items drive attachment and which cannibalize. Ask how many new guests an LTO brought in and how many came back. Ask which stores are gaining guests and which are losing them, or how a loyalty segment is trending. Before it answers, the plugin confirms the exact names of your menu items, locations, promotions, and segments, so the answer matches how your brand reports.

Everything is read-only. The plugin reaches only the businesses your Bikky account already has access to, and only where Bikky has enabled it. It cannot create, change, or delete anything.

Labor and weather data are not available.

You need a Bikky account to use it. Setup takes about two minutes.
payload.longDescription:
销售数据告诉你发生了什么。
Bikky告诉你原因。

Bikky是专为多门店餐厅打造的客户数据平台。
它将您的POS系统、在线订购和会员数据整合到顾客档案中，让您了解每项营销活动、菜单调整和运营决策对顾客的实际影响。

此插件将这些数据接入ChatGPT。
您可以像向分析师提问一样提出问题，直接从您品牌的专属数据中获得答案——无需电子表格、仪表板或过滤器。

可查询不同时段或门店的销售数据、客单价和客流量。
可询问哪些菜单项促进交叉销售，哪些导致产品冲突。
可查询限时产品（LTO）带来了多少新顾客以及回头客数量。
可查询哪些门店正在增加顾客数量，哪些门店正在流失顾客，或会员群体的活跃趋势。
在给出答案前，插件会确认您菜单项、门店位置、促销活动和会员分组的准确名称，确保回答符合您品牌的报告规范。

所有操作均为只读模式。
插件仅能访问您的Bikky账户已授权的门店数据，且仅限Bikky已开启权限的范围。
它无法创建、修改或删除任何内容。

无法获取人力成本和天气数据。

使用前需要拥有Bikky账户。
设置过程约需两分钟。

payload.name: Glippy GEO
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Glippy is a website audit tool for marketers, SEO specialists and web developers. It checks how AI-ready and LLM-friendly a website is: can AI search engines and AI agents find it, read it, and cite it? Use it to optimize your website for AI search, also called AI SEO or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

Name a website and Glippy returns an interactive report:
- An overall GEO score and grade
- 16 scored categories, including structured data, semantic HTML, machine readability, entity and authority signals, citability and content freshness
- Which AI crawlers robots.txt blocks or allows
- Whether the site publishes a sitemap and llms.txt
- A prioritised list of fixes you can copy, or ask for drafts of

You can also compare up to eight sites side by side, for example your site against competitors, and see who leads in each category.

How Glippy fetches: it reads only public files of the site you name (the homepage, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, llms.txt and standard /.well-known discovery files), identifies itself as GlippyBot, and does not fetch a site whose robots.txt disallows GlippyBot. It analyses the homepage, not the whole site. It does not sign in anywhere, change anything on the site, or need an account.
payload.longDescription:
Glippy是面向营销人员、SEO专家和网页开发者的网站审计工具。它可检测网站的AI就绪程度和大型语言模型（LLM）友好性：AI搜索引擎和AI代理能否找到、读取并引用该网站？可用于优化您的网站以适应AI搜索，也称为AI SEO或生成式引擎优化（GEO）

输入一个网站后，Glippy会生成交互式报告：
- 综合GEO评分和等级
- 16个评分类别，包括结构化数据、语义化HTML、机器可读性、实体和权威信号、可引用性及内容新鲜度
- 哪些AI爬虫被robots.txt阻止或允许
- 网站是否发布sitemaps.xml和llms.txt
- 优先修复列表可直接复制，或请求生成草稿

您还可以同时比较最多八个网站，例如将您的网站与竞争对手对比，查看各分类中的领先者

Glippy仅读取您指定网站的公开文件（首页、robots.txt、sitemaps.xml、llms.txt及标准的/.well-known发现文件），以GlippyBot身份标识自身，并不会抓取robots.txt中禁止GlippyBot的网站。它仅分析首页，不涉及整个网站，不需登录任何平台，不修改网站内容，也无需账户

payload.name: Chalet
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Chalet answers short-term rental investing questions with Chalet data: typical revenue, nightly rates, occupancy and seasonality for US markets; income and cash-flow estimates for a specific property based on nearby comparable rentals; and intros to vetted local short-term rental agents. Estimates are based on Chalet data and are not a guarantee of income.
payload.longDescription:
Chalet通过Chalet数据解答短期租赁投资问题：涵盖美国市场典型收入、每晚价格、入住率及季节性特征；基于周边相似租赁数据，提供特定房产的收入与现金流预估；并介绍经过审核的当地短期租赁代理。
预估基于Chalet数据，不构成收入保证。

payload.name: Narron
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Narron helps users inspect how their brands appear in AI search. It reports visibility scores, platform breakdowns, topic performance, competitor share of voice, brand perception, measured prompts and stored improvement suggestions from the user's Lens workspace. Connect your Lens workspace to inspect measurements already stored for brands you can access. The plugin is read-only and cannot start analyses or change workspace data.
payload.longDescription: Narron帮助用户检查其品牌在AI搜索中的呈现情况。它会报告可见性评分、平台分布情况、主题表现、竞争对手的语音份额、品牌认知、已测量的提示以及来自用户Lens工作区的存储改进建议。连接您的Lens工作区，检查您可访问品牌的已存储测量数据。该插件为只读模式，无法启动分析或更改工作区数据。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List brands in your Lens workspace, Report AI search visibility and platform breakdowns, Compare topic and competitor performance, Report measured brand perception and prompts, Show stored improvement suggestions

payload.name: Caprail
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Caprail is a website traffic analytics tool for website owners and developers. Analyze recorded traffic in chat to understand how people and AI agents reach and use your website. View recorded page views, estimated unique visitors, and agentic/chat requests. Identify traffic referred by AI sources, inspect visited pages, compare periods, and explore daily trends. Filter and rank results by page path, country, source, device, browser, provider, or referrer.

Show results as metric cards, comparison cards, line charts, ranked breakdowns, or multi-series charts. The presentation tool can also display ordered conversion funnels when a connected, authorized data source supplies the required cohort counts; Caprail page totals alone do not provide funnel data.

Connect your Caprail account to analyze your own sites and check when requests were last received. In a coding agent with access to your website codebase, use the installation skill to create a site and integrate event collection.

Visitor counts are estimates derived from IP address and user agent. Page views are explicitly recorded events; agent requests are measured separately. Interactive components require a compatible host. Text and structured results remain available.
payload.longDescription:
Caprail是网站所有者和开发者的网站流量分析工具。通过聊天记录分析流量，了解用户和AI代理如何访问和使用您的网站。查看记录的页面浏览量、预估独立访客以及代理/聊天请求。识别由AI来源带来的流量，检查访问页面，对比不同时期并探索每日趋势。按页面路径、国家、来源、设备、浏览器、提供商或引荐来源过滤和排序结果。

以指标卡片、对比卡片、折线图、排名分解图或多系列图表形式展示结果。当连接的授权数据源提供所需的群体数量时，展示工具还可显示有序转化漏斗；仅Caprail页面总数无法提供漏斗数据。

访问量是基于IP地址和用户代理的估算值。页面浏览量是明确记录的事件；代理请求单独进行统计。交互式组件需要兼容的主机环境。文本和结构化结果仍可使用。

payload.name: Knowi
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Knowi is an AI-native business intelligence platform. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your Knowi account so you can ask questions of your data, build and update dashboards, and manage reports and alerts without leaving the conversation.

What you can do:
- Ask questions in plain English. Knowi resolves the right datasets, runs the query, and returns results, with a chart when one helps.
- Explore what already exists: search dashboards, widgets, datasets, queries, and alerts; pull the data behind any widget; trace lineage and see how a business term was resolved.
- Build: create datasources and queries (Cloud9QL or your database's native language), create and lay out widgets and dashboards, and export results to CSV or PDF.
- Automate: create and test alerts, schedule and update reports, and deliver them by email, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
- Manage the semantic layer: define, map, and publish glossary terms so questions resolve consistently across your team.
- Work with documents: ingest PDFs, Word, Excel, CSV, and images, ask questions about their contents, and extract structured data from them.

Every tool runs as you, so data access follows your Knowi role and asset permissions. Tools that create, modify, or delete Knowi assets are marked as write or destructive, so the assistant confirms before making changes; read-only tools run without prompts.

Requirements: a Knowi account. Sign in with OAuth when you connect; there are no API keys to copy.
payload.longDescription:
Knowi是一个原生人工智能商业智能平台。该插件将ChatGPT和Codex连接到您的Knowi账户，您可以在对话界面中直接向数据提问、构建和更新仪表盘、管理报告和警报。

您可以：
- 用自然语言提问。
Knowi会定位正确数据集，执行查询并返回结果，必要时会附带图表。
- 探索现有内容：搜索仪表盘、组件、数据集、查询和警报；提取任意组件背后的数据；追溯数据血缘关系并查看业务术语的解析过程。
- 构建：创建数据源和查询（使用Cloud9QL或您数据库的原生语言），设计和布局组件及仪表盘，并将结果导出为CSV或PDF格式。
- 自动化：创建并测试警报，安排并更新报告，通过邮件、Slack或Microsoft Teams发送。
- 管理语义层：定义、映射并发布术语表条目，确保团队内提问解析的一致性。
- 处理文档：导入PDF、Word、Excel、CSV和图片文件，询问其内容并从中提取结构化数据。

所有工具均以您的身份运行，数据访问权限遵循您的Knowi角色设置。
执行创建、修改或删除Knowi资产的操作会被标记为写入或破坏性操作，助手会在执行前确认；只读操作则无需提示。

要求：需拥有Knowi账户。
连接时通过OAuth登录；无需复制API密钥。
